2024-01-14.enTitle: Green Footprints: our first coastal clean-up of 2024 ✨
2024-01-14.enBody:
On 14 January 2024 LucaBridge held its first coastal clean-up of the year, starting at the beach off Choi To Garden in Sham Tseng.

From noon until four in the afternoon our volunteers worked through the heat, clearing waste along the shoreline. Four hours later we had filled 15 bags. Thank you to everyone who gave their time to look after the sea and helped return this stretch of sand to its old self. Let's carry that same energy forward and keep protecting our blue backyard.

2024-01-14.scTitle: 绿色足迹：2024首场海岸清洁日顺利完成！✨
2024-01-14.scBody: 在2024年1月14日，乐桥举办了本年度首个海岸清洁日！我们的第一站来到了深井彩涛花园对开沙滩。当天中午12点至下午4点期间，一众义工齐心协力，无惧烈日，专注清理岸边的废弃物。经过4小时的努力，我们合共清走了15袋垃圾！感谢每一位为守护海洋出一分力的朋友，让这片沙滩回复昔日的光彩。让我们继续带著这份热诚，守护我们的蓝色家园！

2024-03-31.enTitle: Grey skies, undeterred — coastal clean-up, round two
2024-03-31.enBody:
By 31 March 2024 our green programme was in full swing. The day was overcast but the rain held off, and it did nothing to dampen the volunteers' determination.

Out we went again, working carefully along the coastline. There is real satisfaction in watching bag after bag of waste get properly cleared away — 11 bags in total that day. Protecting the environment was never going to be the work of a single afternoon. It is your persistence, step by step, that makes the coast better. We look forward to seeing you all at the next one.

2025-01-05.enTitle: Guarding the shoreline against the odds: five full bags of plastic and broken glass cleared from Siu Lam beach 💪
2025-01-05.enVenue: Siu Lam coastal waste reduction drive
2025-01-05.enBody:
On 5 January 2025 our environmental team went out again, this time to the Siu Lam coast. The sun was out, but the volume of litter hiding in the sand was not to be underestimated — it tested both our volunteers' stamina and their eyesight.

The moment we reached the beach we could see how much the waves had washed ashore. The hardest of it was the plastic waste everywhere, and the broken glass buried in the sand, which is genuinely dangerous. To get the shoreline clean, our volunteers turned themselves into guardians of the place: gloves on, pickers out, working methodically across the sand and between the rocks.

Nobody complained about aching backs. Every fragment was lifted out one by one, so that neither beachgoers nor marine life would get hurt. After a morning of sweat and teamwork the result was substantial: five full bags of plastic waste and a large quantity of broken glass. Watching a messy beach return to being beautiful and safe was worth every minute — even the sea breeze felt fresher.

Our respect to every volunteer who turned up and worked without complaint. Every time you bent down, you took a little weight off the planet. There is a long way to go, but with you alongside us we can carry this further. See you at the next clean-up. ✨

2025-01-05.scTitle: 守护海岸，迎难而上！小榄沙滩大作战，齐心清理五大袋塑胶与碎玻璃 💪
2025-01-05.scBody:
喺2025年1月5日，乐桥嘅环保大队再度出动，今次我哋嘅减废脚步嚟到咗小榄海岸！虽然当日阳光普照，但沙滩上隐藏嘅垃圾量真系不容忽视，为一众义工带来咗一场体力同眼力嘅大考验！一踏入沙滩，大家就见到大量被海浪冲上岸嘅垃圾。今次最难搞嘅，莫过于无处不在嘅塑胶废物同埋隐藏喺沙入面、非常危险嘅碎玻璃！为咗还原洁净嘅海岸，一众热血义工即刻变身「环境守护者」，带起手套、执起夹子，逐一喺沙滩同石缝之间展开地毯式搜寻。

大家不顾腰酸背痛，仔细咁将碎片一件件执起，确保前嚟游玩嘅市民同海洋生物唔会受伤。经过大家一成朝嘅汗水同齐心协力，成果极之丰硕——我哋足足清理咗五大袋塑胶垃圾同大量碎玻璃！看著原本杂乱嘅沙滩喺大家努力下回复原本嘅美丽与安全，那一刻嘅成就感真系爆灯，连吹过嚟嘅海风都觉得特别清爽！在这里向当日无惧辛劳、默默付出嘅每一位热血义工伙伴致敬，你哋每一吓弯腰，都为地球减少咗一份负担。

环保路漫长，但有你哋同行，我哋一定可以将绿色力量传得更远。下一场减废行动，期待继续见到你嘅身影！✨

2025-04-02.enTitle: Coastal clean-up at Tsing Lung Tau Pier
2025-04-02.enBody:
🌊 Today our environmental volunteers headed for the shoreline beside Tsing Lung Tau Pier. This stretch is rougher going than most — the shore is covered in rocks of every size, which makes collecting litter considerably harder.

Our volunteers were not put off. Helping each other up and down, they searched methodically through the gaps between the rocks and pulled out plastic bottles, packaging, discarded fishing net and more, all washed in by the tide. A morning's work produced four heavy bags.

Hard going, but seeing the coast clean again made it worth it. Thank you to every volunteer who came. Let's keep doing our bit for the planet, and keep looking after our sea and sky. ✨

2025-05-27.enTitle: Clear skies, clean seas — early summer clean-up restores the Siu Lam shoreline 💪
2025-05-27.enBody:
Early summer, and our environmental team was out again. On 27 May 2025 a group of volunteers took their equipment down to Siu Lam beach for a coastal waste clean-up.

The early-summer heat was fierce but enthusiasm held up. The beach was strewn with plastic bottles, disposable cutlery and marine litter of every kind, all washed up by the waves. Gloves on and bags in hand, the volunteers worked the length of the shoreline, clearing even the small pieces wedged into the rocks.

A morning of sweat and good teamwork removed 8 bags of waste and gave Siu Lam back its golden sand. The satisfaction on everyone's faces at the end outshone the sun. Our sincere thanks to every volunteer who stood in the heat and gave their time — it is only with you beside us that the sea stays healthy and beautiful. We are not stopping. ✨

2025-05-27.scTitle: 守护蓝天碧海！初夏进击小榄海滩，齐心合力还原洁净海岸线 💪
2025-05-27.scBody:
踏入初夏，乐桥嘅环保大队再次出动！喺2025年5月27日，我哋一班热血义工带埋装备，前进到小榄海滩展开一场别具意义嘅海岸减废行动！当日顶住初夏嘅热浪，大家嘅环保热情依然高涨。海滩上布满咗唔少被海浪冲上岸嘅塑胶樽、即弃餐具同各式各样嘅海洋垃圾。义工们无惧烈日晒、不怕流汗，带起手套、拎起垃圾袋，喺长长嘅海岸线上展开地毯式搜寻，连石缝入面嘅微细垃圾都通通清理干净！

经过大家一成朝嘅汗水同分工合作，成功将8袋垃圾运走，令小榄海滩再次回复原本嘅金黄沙滩与洁净美景。看着成果一刻，大家脸上嘅满足与成就感简直比太阳仲要耀眼！非常感谢当日每一位无惧日晒、默默为环保付出嘅热血义工伙伴，有你哋嘅并肩同行，我哋嘅海洋先可以维持美丽与健康。绿色行动，我们不会停步，继续同你一齐守护地球！✨

2025-05-31.enTitle: Our smallest ambassadors: children hand out noodle care packages at Pau Cheung Square and melt a few hearts 👶❤
2025-05-31.enVenue: Pau Cheung Square, Wah Yuen Noodles outreach
2025-05-31.enBody:
On the last day of May our volunteer team took its work to Wah Yuen Noodles at Pau Cheung Square in Yuen Long — a busy spot, full of local character.

Alongside our usual volunteers we had some very special helpers that day: our youngest volunteers, who came along to bring 150 care packages and a good deal of happiness into the neighbourhood. The place was buzzing from early on, with elderly residents and neighbours arriving to support us. When a group of bright, lively children carried the care packages over, offered their greetings in small clear voices and handed the packages of everyday essentials to the elderly residents themselves, the whole room softened.

The elderly residents beamed at these well-mannered young helpers, taking their hands and praising them without pause. That kind of care passed between generations is worth more than almost anything else we do. Watching the smiles and hearing one heartfelt thank-you after another, the warmth in that room was something else.

Our sincere thanks to Wah Yuen Noodles for their full support and for hosting us, and our respect to every volunteer, large and small, who put in the work — particularly the parents who brought their children along to do good in person. You are planting something in them that will last. 💖🎒

2025-05-31.scTitle: 最萌爱心大使！炮仗坊华苑粉面福袋大派送，小朋友亲手送暖融化长者心 👶❤
2025-05-31.scVenue: 炮仗坊华苑粉面送暖行动
2025-05-31.scBody:
喺5月份嘅最后一天，乐桥义工大队嘅关怀脚步嚟到咗热闹又充满本土情怀嘅元朗炮仗坊华苑粉面！今次嘅活动除咗有一班一如既往咁热血嘅大义工之外，仲迎来咗一班超级特别嘅「小帮手」——我哋可爱嘅小朋友义工，一齐将150份福袋同快乐带入社区！当日现场极之热闹，一早就有好多老友记同街坊前来支持。当一班精灵活泼嘅小朋友捧住暖心福袋，用稚嫩又响亮嘅声音向长者送上节日问候，并亲手将装满健康物资嘅福袋递到长者手上时，全场嘅气氛即刻被融化！

老友记们见到呢班咁乖巧嘅小义工，个个都笑到逐颜开，拉住小朋友嘅手赞不绝口。呢种跨代嘅关爱与传承，真系比任何嘢都更加珍贵、更加动人！看著街坊们灿烂嘅笑容，听著一声声真挚嘅「谢谢」，那一刻现场流淌著嘅人情味真系爆灯！非常感谢华苑粉面嘅全力支持同场地配合，亦要向成班大大小小、出汗出力嘅热血义工伙伴致敬——特别系各位带埋小朋友一齐身体力行做善事嘅家长，你哋为小朋友栽种下善良嘅种子！爱心传承，乐桥不停步，让我们继续并肩同行 💖🎒

2025-07-12.enTitle: Into Shui Pin Wai: care packages at Sing Gor Bing Sutt bring the neighbourhood closer ✨
2025-07-12.enVenue: Sing Gor Bing Sutt, Shui Pin Wai Estate, Yuen Long
2025-07-12.enBody:
On 12 July 2025 our volunteer team headed into Shui Pin Wai Estate in Yuen Long, with generous support from Sing Gor Bing Sutt, for a care package distribution that was as warm as it was down to earth.

It was a hot weekend, but nothing next to the warmth of the residents who turned out. A queue formed outside the bing sutt early on. Our volunteers were on good form and quickly fell into a rhythm, filling and handing over 150 care packages of everyday health items and useful food to each elderly resident who came.

As they handed the packages over, the volunteers chatted with residents and asked after them. There was laughter throughout, and a real sense of neighbourliness running through the estate. Seeing the satisfaction on people's faces as they took their packages, and hearing all those kind words of thanks, made every drop of sweat worth it.

Our heartfelt thanks to Sing Gor Bing Sutt for hosting us and backing the day, and full credit to a team of volunteers who never flag. It is your consistency that keeps this community warm. We're not stopping.

It was a hot weekend, but nothing next to the warmth of the residents who turned out. A queue formed outside the bing sutt early on.
2025-07-12.scTitle: 走入水边围！盛哥冰室暖心福袋大派送，用爱心拉近社区每个距离 ✨
2025-07-12.scVenue: 元朗水边围邨盛哥冰室送暖行动
2025-07-12.scBody:
喺2025年7月12日，乐桥义工大队嘅关怀步伐踏进咗充满人情味嘅元朗水边围邨，并得到盛哥冰室嘅大力支持，携手举办咗一场超贴地、超温馨嘅福袋大派送活动！当日周末嘅天气虽然炎热，但完全比不上现场街坊长者们嘅热情。冰室门前早早就排起咗长龙，义工们个个打足精神、打成一片，分工合作将150份福袋装满日常健康物资同实用食品嘅暖心福袋，亲手递到每一位前来嘅老友记手上。

2025-07-27.enTitle: A table full of care: hot meals and care packages shared with residents ✨
2025-07-27.enBody:
On 27 July 2025 our volunteer team joined the Sing Fai meal distribution, bringing 100 care packages of good wishes and everyday health items into the neighbourhood for a full and warm-hearted day.

The atmosphere was lively from the start, with elderly residents and neighbours waiting well before we began. Our volunteers were sharp, split the work between them, and handed each carefully prepared package of essentials to every person who came.

Beyond the supplies, the volunteers spent time greeting people, chatting and joking. There was laughter everywhere, and the warmth in the room went straight to the top. Seeing the kind smiles on the elderly residents' faces as they took their packages, and hearing their thanks, made all the lifting and carrying feel worthwhile.

Our sincere thanks to Sing Fai Restaurant for their full support, the use of their space and their willing help, and our respect to every volunteer who gave their time to bring some warmth into this community. We'll keep going. ❤🍱

2025-08-02.enTitle: Black rainstorm, no excuses — volunteers young and old run a flag day for Hong Kong Rehabilitation Power at Kai Tin Shopping Centre 💪❤
2025-08-02.enVenue: Kai Tin Shopping Centre, Lam Tin
2025-08-02.enBody:
This was a day that showed what standing together actually means. On 2 August 2025, with a black rainstorm warning in force and heavy rain across Hong Kong, our volunteers went out anyway.

Our thanks to the friend who invited us, giving us the chance to run a flag day at Kai Tin Shopping Centre in Lam Tin in aid of Hong Kong Rehabilitation Power. What moved us most was the make-up of the team itself: not just young volunteers, but energetic elderly residents and some very bright young children too.

Volunteers of every age made their way through the storm and arrived early. Outside the wind and rain were relentless; inside the shopping centre the mood could not have been warmer. The children held their collection bags and made their appeal to passers-by in clear, sincere voices, while the older volunteers greeted every shopper with a smile. Seeing three generations doing good side by side, many shoppers stopped, reached into their pockets, and gave what they could towards rehabilitation and employment support for people with disabilities.

The sky outside was black; inside, everyone was glowing. By the end of the day the collection bags were satisfyingly heavy. Our deepest respect to every elderly volunteer, every child and every parent who came out in a black rainstorm and arrived on time. You proved the point: with enough goodwill, no weather stops us. Thank you too to the people of Kai Tin who gave so generously. 👧👵🎒

Our thanks to the friend who invited us, giving us the chance to run a flag day at Kai Tin Shopping Centre in Lam Tin in aid of Hong Kong Rehabilitation Power.
2025-08-02.scTitle: 风雨无阻，爱心同行！黑雨下进击启田商场，大小义工齐心为「香港康复力量」热血卖旗 💪❤
2025-08-02.scVenue: 黑雨中的蓝田启田商场义卖旗行动
2025-08-02.scBody:
这是一场真正展现「风雨同舟」精神嘅难忘日子！喺2025年8月2日，虽然外面正悬挂著黑色暴雨警告信号，全港暴雨连连，但完全无阻乐桥义工队伍前进嘅步伐！非常感谢朋友嘅诚意邀请，让我哋有机会来到蓝田启田商场，为「香港康复力量」展开极具意义嘅卖旗筹款活动！当日最令人动容同振奋嘅，系我哋嘅义工阵容——当中不单止有热血嘅青年人，仲有充满活力嘅长者老友记，以及精灵可爱嘅小朋友义工！

一班「大小义工」大步跨过风雨，一早赶到商场。虽然出面风大雨大，但启田商场内部却洋溢著最温暖嘅气氛。小朋友们捧住旗袋，用最清脆、最诚恳嘅声音向途人呼吁；长者们亦精神抖擞，用亲切嘅笑容感染著每一位街坊。见到呢个跨代共融、齐心做善事嘅画面，好多前来购物嘅街坊都纷纷停下脚步，慷慨解囊，将一枚枚硬币同纸币投入旗袋，为残疾人士嘅康复与就业发展出一分力！

外面嘅天气系黑色的，但大家嘅内心却是金黄灿烂的。经过大半日嘅努力，看著旗袋渐渐变沉，大家脸上嘅成就感简直爆灯！在这里要向当日每一位冒著黑雨、无惧恶劣天气依然准时出席嘅长者、小朋友同家长义工致以最崇高嘅敬意！你哋用行动证明咗：只要有爱，风雨再大都阻挡唔到我哋前行。亦非常感谢启田商场街坊们嘅热情支持！爱心凝聚，乐桥不停步，让我们继续并肩同行！👧👵🎒

2025-08-10.enTitle: Summer warmth for On Sum Kui: care packages for the elderly residents of Yuen Long ☀
2025-08-10.enVenue: On Sum Kui Home for the Elderly, Yuen Long
2025-08-10.enBody:
On 10 August 2025 our volunteer team arrived at On Sum Kui Home for the Elderly in Yuen Long, carrying summer enthusiasm and a good supply of provisions, for a lively and warm-hearted care package distribution.

It was high summer, but the heat was no match for the mood in the room. The volunteers got straight to work, dividing tasks and handing 110 care packages of everyday health items and useful food to each resident in person.

More valued than the supplies was the time spent face to face — sitting with residents, asking after their health, listening to their stories. There was laughter throughout. Watching the elderly residents' faces light up as they took their packages, holding on to the volunteers' hands and not wanting to let go, that warmth going both ways got to every volunteer in the room.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at On Sum Kui for their full cooperation and careful arrangements, and full credit to the volunteers who worked hard all day. With you alongside us, summer here is a good deal cooler and a good deal warmer at once. 👴💖

It was high summer, but the heat was no match for the mood in the room.

2025-08-10.scVenue: 元朗安心居老人院送暖
2025-08-10.scBody:

除了送上丰富的物资，大家最珍惜的就是与长者们面对面倾计、话家常的陪伴时光。义工们贴心地询问长者们的身体状况，听他们分享生活趣事，现场不断传出欢声笑语，温馨指数直接爆灯！看到老友记们接过福袋时露出慈祥灿烂的笑容，拉著义工的手不愿放开，那份双向奔赴的温暖，融化了在场每一位义工的心。在这里衷心感谢安心居院舍全体工作人员的全力配合与贴心安排，亦要大赞当日不辞劳苦、出汗出力的大爱义工伙伴！

有你哋的同行，长者们的夏天变得格外清凉与温暖。关爱长者，乐桥不停步，继续将正能量传递落去！👴💖

2025-08-10-2.enTitle: A full house of creativity: parent-and-child Daruma painting workshop paints a wish for everyone ✨
2025-08-10-2.enVenue: Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education x LucaBridge: parent-and-child Daruma painting workshop
2025-08-10-2.enBody:
On 10 August 2025 LucaBridge teamed up with Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education to run a Daruma painting workshop full of colour and laughter.

The session was built around parents and children doing something together, and it drew plenty of families with lively young children ready to be creative. In traditional culture the Daruma doll stands for perseverance and for wishes fulfilled. Under the guidance of a professional instructor, six participants of various ages set off on an afternoon of making.

The children turned into small artists, picking up brushes, loading them with colour and concentrating hard on giving their Daruma a design nobody else would have. Parents helped alongside them, guiding and praising in equal measure, and the room filled with discussion and laughter. After most of a day, one distinctive, brightly painted Daruma after another was finished. Watching the children hold up their work for a group photo with their parents, proud and pleased with themselves, was a genuine tonic.

Our sincere thanks to Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education for their full support and for a venue that worked perfectly, and to every family who came and threw themselves into it. Because of you, the children came away having made something and having learned a little about persistence and good wishes. ❤✨

The session was built around parents and children doing something together, and it drew plenty of families with lively young children ready to be creative.
2025-08-10-2.scTitle: 创意满满！达摩彩绘亲子体验班圆满成功，大小朋友齐心画出专属祝福 ✨
2025-08-10-2.scVenue: 智桥外国语教育x乐桥：达摩彩绘亲子体验班
2025-08-10-2.scBody:

现场嘅小朋友个个化身「小艺术家」，拿起画笔、沾上缤纷嘅颜料，专注咁喺达摩公仔上勾勒出独一无二嘅图案；而爸爸妈妈就喺身边贴心协助，一边引导、一边赞赏，现场满满都是互相讨论同欢笑嘅声音，亲子间嘅默契与温情瞬间拉满！经过大半日嘅努力，一尊尊充满个性、色彩斑斓嘅专属达摩公仔陆续诞生！看到小朋友们兴高采烈咁捧住自己嘅作品，同爸爸妈妈一齐影大合照，脸上露出满足又自豪嘅笑容，那一刻嘅画面真系无比治愈！

在这里衷心感谢智桥外国语教育嘅全力支持同完美场地配合，亦要谢谢每一组前来参与、投入100%热情嘅精灵家庭！因为有你哋嘅支持，等小朋友喺动手创作嘅同时，更学懂了坚持与祝福嘅意义。爱心与创意并行，乐桥不停步，继续同大家一齐探索、一齐进步！❤✨

2025-08-17.enTitle: One moment that stayed with us: care packages, tears and smiles at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly 👵
2025-08-17.enVenue: Yan Wo Home for the Elderly, Pat Heung
2025-08-17.enBody:
On 17 August 2025 our volunteer team visited Yan Wo Home for the Elderly in Pat Heung, a top-rated residential home, bringing supplies and, we hoped, some warmth and company for the residents.

The day was as lively as ever. Our volunteers divided the work between them and handed 35 care packages of everyday health items to residents in person. During the distribution came a moment that stayed with all of us. As we passed a package to one elderly gentleman and offered a quiet greeting, he looked at the weight of the gift in his hands and at the sincere faces in front of him, and his eyes reddened. He took a volunteer's hand and held on to it for a long time.

There was not much said, but the gratitude in that look shook everyone in the room. It brought home something real: what we hand over is not just a care package, it is the message that someone remembers you, that a younger generation is still paying attention.

The other residents were in high spirits too, taking volunteers by the hand to chat and share news, and the home filled with a very particular kind of warmth. Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Yan Wo for their help and careful arrangements, and our respect to every volunteer who brought patience and real care and took the time to understand what the residents needed.

Because of your gentle company, this community has a little more warmth in it. 👴✨

The day was as lively as ever. Our volunteers divided the work between them and handed 35 care packages of everyday health items to residents in person.
2025-08-17.scTitle: 一刹那的感动！走入八乡恩和安老院，暖心福袋擦亮长者泪光与笑容 👵 Tears of Joy
2025-08-17.scVenue: 八乡恩和安老院送暖行动
2025-08-17.scBody:
喺2025年8月17日，乐桥义工大队嘅关怀步伐踏进咗位于八乡嘅甲一级优质院舍——恩和安老院。我哋带备了物资，希望喺这个日子为院舍嘅老友记们带来一份暖心嘅问候与关怀。当日活动一如既往咁热闹，一班热血义工分工合作，亲手将35袋装满日常健康物资嘅暖心福袋送到长者们手中。而在派发嘅过程中，发生了一个令全场义工都无比动容嘅深刻画面——当我哋将福袋递到其中一位老人家手上、并送上轻声嘅问候时，长者看著手中这份沉甸甸嘅礼物与眼前一张张真挚嘅笑脸，一瞬间感动得红了眼眶，紧紧拉住义工嘅手久久不愿放开。

那一刻，没有太多言语，但那份眼神中透露出嘅感激与触动，深深震撼咗在场每一位义工嘅心灵。这份真实嘅情感流露，让我哋切切实实感受到：我哋送出嘅不单止是一个福袋，更是一份被社会记得、被后辈关怀嘅尊重与温暖。除咗这位老友记嘅真情流露，其他长者亦个个笑逐颜开，拉住义工倾计、话家常，院舍内充满著温馨嘅气氛。在这里衷心感谢恩和安老院全体职员嘅全力协助同贴心安排，更要向当日每一位付出百分百耐心与大爱、用心感悟长者需要嘅热血义工致敬！

因为有你哋嘅温柔陪伴，社区先可以变得咁有温度。爱心因陪伴而美丽，乐桥不停步，带著这份感动继续并肩同行！👴✨

2025-08-23.enTitle: Father and son at the top table: a charity Pokémon TCG tournament at Din Din House, with YouTuber Mimi on hand for the showdown ⚡🏆
2025-08-23.enVenue: Din Din House charity Pokémon TCG tournament, Hung Hom
2025-08-23.enBody:
On 23 August 2025 our charity Pokémon TCG tournament at Din Din House in Hung Hom produced more than its share of memorable moments.

Popular YouTuber Mimi joined us on the day, but the thing nobody saw coming — and the thing that had the whole room cheering — was what happened on the tables: two of the competitors turned out to be father and son. Card games are supposed to be a young person's game, but this pair had both signed up, and the draw put them against each other.

At home they are family; the moment they sat down opposite one another, something shifted, and they became two trainers with complete respect for their opponent. The father played steadily, balanced between attack and defence; the son was quick-thinking and full of surprises. Both of them calculated damage and flipped prize cards while openly admiring each other's tactics. The room went quiet — Mimi and the other competitors included — and then got behind them both. Whoever won, the high five and the hug at the end took the warmth in that room to its limit.

That bond, well past any question of winning, is exactly what a charity tournament is for. Plenty of other families played side by side that day, and Din Din House was full of laughter and card-game enthusiasm from start to finish. Watching everyone collect their prizes and pose for photos with Mimi, our volunteers came away with a real sense of having done something worthwhile.

Our sincere thanks to Din Din House for the venue, to meowcardhk for sponsoring the prizes, and to Mimi for lending her time, and our respect to the father and son who gave us all something to remember, and to every family who took part. Because of you, both the funds and the warmth get passed along. ⚡🎒🔥🏆

平时喺屋企相亲相爱，一坐上对战席，两父子即刻眼神一变，化身成最尊重对手嘅最强训练家。爸爸出招沉稳、攻防有度；个仔就头脑灵活、奇招尽出。两个人一边全神贯注咁计算伤害、翻开奖赏卡，一边互相欣赏对方嘅战术。那一刻，全场连YouTuber咪咪同埋其他围观嘅参赛者都屏息静气，一齐为呢对父子欢呼打气！最后无论边个赢，两父子完赛后𠮶个深情嘅击掌同拥抱，直接将全场嘅温馨同感动指数拉到最满！

呢份超越胜负嘅亲子羁绊，完美诠释咗今次慈善赛嘅真正意义。除咗呢场世纪之战，当日亦有好多家庭并肩作战，令成个红磡电电屋都充满住欢笑声同卡牌狂热。看著大家捧住奖品、同咪咪影大合照时嘅灿烂笑容，我哋嘅热血义工都觉得超级有成就感！衷心感谢红磡电电屋嘅场地配合meowcardhk赞助礼物、YouTuber咪咪嘅大爱帮手，亦要向这对为我哋带来无限感动嘅父子选手以及所有参赛家庭致敬！

有你哋，善款与温暖才可以一齐传递出去。热血不灭，乐桥不停步，期待下一场更精彩、更惊喜嘅社区大作战！⚡🎒🔥🏆

2025-08-24.enTitle: Back by demand: the Daruma painting class returns, and everyone paints their own good fortune ✨
2025-08-24.enBody:
The response to the first session was so strong that on 24 August 2025 LucaBridge and Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education put on a second Daruma painting workshop for parents and children.

It sold out again the moment it opened, and the room filled once more with families ready to get stuck in. Word of mouth from the first session meant the six participants arrived even keener. Brushes moved, colour flew, and the children cradled their round Daruma dolls while letting their imaginations run, painting on colours that stand for good fortune and for sticking at things.

Parents worked in step beside them, passing paints and designing patterns together, and the room filled with warm laughter and encouragement. One by one, creative and entirely individual Daruma dolls took shape. Watching the children hold up their work proudly for photos with their families, those smiles were the best verdict on the day we could have asked for.

Our thanks again to Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education for their full support, and to every family who came and gave it everything. It is your enthusiasm that made this extra session work. We'll keep finding new things to explore together — see you at the next one. ❤

2025-08-30.enTitle: The team keeps growing: care packages at Lung Hei, with new volunteers joining us on the day 💪✨
2025-08-30.enVenue: Lung Hei meal and care package outreach
2025-08-30.enBody:
As August drew to a close, on 30 August 2025, our volunteer team headed to a busy Lung Hei. We had 400 well-filled care packages of health items and everyday essentials ready, and a weekend greeting to go with them.

The best part of the day was how many new volunteers had joined us, bringing a fresh burst of energy to the team. The turnout was as strong as ever, with elderly residents queuing early.

Although the new volunteers were with us for the first time, every one of them slotted straight in. The work divided itself up, experienced hands showed newcomers the ropes, and between moving supplies, laying out packages and keeping the queue orderly, you would have thought they had all worked together for years. When new and old volunteers handed packages over together with a warm greeting, the satisfied smiles that came back were the best encouragement this team could ask for. Watching the new volunteers sweating and grinning at the same time, having discovered that helping people is its own reward, the warmth in that place went right up.

Our respect to every volunteer who gave their time and effort — and a particularly loud welcome to our new volunteer family. Thank you for choosing to walk alongside LucaBridge and for spreading a little more goodwill through what you did. Our thanks too to Lung Hei for their full support and for hosting us. Because of all of you, this team keeps growing. ❤🎒🍱

We had 400 well-filled care packages of health items and everyday essentials ready, and a weekend greeting to go with them. The best part of the day was how many new volunteers had joined us, bringing a fresh burst of energy to the team.

虽然新伙伴们系第一次参加我哋嘅活动，但个个都极速融入、打成一片！大家分工合作，老手带新手，搬物资、排福袋、维持秩序，默契简直好似合作咗好耐一样。当新旧义工一齐将福袋亲手递到老友记手上，并用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音送上问候时，街坊们接过福袋露出嘅满足笑容，就是对我哋整个团队最大嘅鼓励！看到新伙伴们在挥汗如雨嘅同时，脸上亦洋溢著助人为快乐之本嘅灿烂笑容，那一刻，社区嘅人情味同义工们嘅热血温度直接爆棚！

在这里要向当日每一位无私付出、出汗出力嘅热血义工致敬——特别要大声欢迎我哋呢班新加入嘅义工家人们，多谢你哋选择与乐桥同行，用行动将善良嘅种子撒播得更远！同时亦非常感谢龙禧嘅全力支持与场地配合。因为有你们，爱心队伍越来越壮大！乐桥不停步，带著这份新力量继续并肩前行，将正能量传遍每一个角落！❤🎒🍱

2025-08-31.enTitle: Closing out August: hot meal boxes and care packages at Sing Fai Restaurant 🔥✨
2025-08-31.enVenue: Sing Fai Restaurant meal and care package outreach
2025-08-31.enBody:
On the afternoon of 31 August 2025 our volunteers were still going. Making the most of August's last few hours, we headed in numbers to Sing Fai Restaurant, a place full of neighbourhood character, for an afternoon of meal and care package distribution.

A Sunday afternoon did nothing to dull the team's enthusiasm. Everyone arrived on top form and organised themselves into a very efficient operation, handing 100 hot, fragrant meal boxes together with care packages of everyday health items to each resident who came.

The afternoon sun was warm, but nowhere near as warm as the mood in the room. As they handed things over, the volunteers reminded the elderly residents to look after themselves and to take care getting home. Watching the relief on people's faces as they took a hot meal and a package, and hearing all those heartfelt thank-yous, left every volunteer feeling restored, however much lifting they had done.

A loud thank you to Sing Fai Restaurant for their full support, for preparing the food and for hosting us so well, and our deepest respect to every volunteer who made time on the last day of August to come and put in the work.

Because you keep turning up, this community stays warm. A good end to August, and we are not stopping. ❤🎒🍱

A Sunday afternoon did nothing to dull the team's enthusiasm.

2025-09-04.enTitle: Star power in Yuen Long: care packages on the eve of Yu Lan Festival, with thanks to the Lung family and celebrity volunteers Yan Chin-man and Tsang Man-sum 🌟❤
2025-09-04.enVenue: Wah Yuen Noodles, Yuen Long — Yu Lan Festival eve outreach
2025-09-04.enBody:
On the eve of Yu Lan Festival, a day given over to remembrance and gratitude, our volunteer team headed to Wah Yuen Noodles in Yuen Long for a care package distribution with a considerable line-up behind it.

First and most importantly, our thanks to the Lung family and Wui Kong International Trading Company for their generous sponsorship. Because of their support we were able to prepare 150 well-stocked care packages of health items and everyday essentials.

The real surprise of the day was the arrival of two well-known volunteers: Yan Chin-man and Tsang Man-sum came in person to help. Neither stood on ceremony for a moment. They folded straight into the LucaBridge family and worked alongside our regular volunteers. The residents of Yuen Long could hardly believe it, and the mood went up several notches. Both of them smiled their way through the whole afternoon, handing over heavy packages by hand, steadying elderly residents on their feet, chatting with them and offering their festival greetings.

The residents took their packages beaming, holding on to the volunteers' hands with praise for everyone. Watching those satisfied faces and hearing thank you after thank you, our volunteers — who had spent the day shifting supplies and sweating through it — knew exactly why they had come.

Our sincere thanks again to the Lung family and Wui Kong International Trading Company for their sponsorship, to Wah Yuen Noodles for their full cooperation, and to Yan Chin-man and Tsang Man-sum for giving their time so generously. And full credit, as always, to every volunteer who keeps showing up. 🔥🎒🍜

2025-09-04-2.enTitle: Day one of our free Chinese medicine clinic: practitioners take the pulse of the neighbourhood 🌿❤
2025-09-04-2.enVenue: Free Chinese medicine clinic, day one
2025-09-04-2.enBody:
This was a day worth marking. On 4 September 2025 LucaBridge's free Chinese medicine clinic — long in the planning — opened for the first time.

The idea behind this new programme is to bring professional, attentive healthcare directly into the community, for residents and elderly people who may not otherwise get the chance to look after their health properly. For a first session the mood was both serious and warm. We were fortunate to have the full support of professional Chinese medicine practitioners, who arrived early to set up and offered free pulse diagnosis, health consultations and advice on staying well.

The practitioners were thorough and gentle throughout, taking pulses and examining tongues while explaining what they found in plain language and advising on what to eat and what to avoid. Watching the elderly residents leave their consultations looking reassured, thanking the practitioners and volunteers on the way out, was hard to put into words.

A clinic like this is not only about diagnosis; it is a practical form of care for people whose health can easily go unattended. Our deepest respect to the professional practitioners who gave everything on day one, and full credit to the attentive volunteers who worked alongside them. Because of you, our first day ran smoothly and felt like something.

The clinic is now properly under way, and we intend to keep looking after more people's health from here. 🌟🌿🩺

中医师更是一步到位、温柔细致，一边认真切脉、看舌苔，一边用最通俗易懂嘅语言同老友记讲解身体状况，叮嘱平时嘅饮食禁忌。看到长者们问诊完后，一脸安心、如释重负咁向医师同义工连声道谢，那一刻，大家内心嘅感动同成就感简直无法言喻！呢个义诊服务不单止是把脉看病，更是一份对基层健康嘅实质守护同关怀。在这里要向第一天就倾力付出、医者父母心嘅专业中医师团队致以最崇高嘅敬意！

亦要大赞现场一班细心爆灯、出汗出力嘅热血义工伙伴！因为有你哋嘅并肩作战，我哋嘅中医义诊第一日才可以办得咁顺利、咁有温度！医疗送暖，乐桥不停步！义诊服务正式扬帆启航，未来我哋会继续守护更多人嘅健康，继续将这份大爱传递落去！🌟🌿🩺

2025-09-06.enTitle: Small eco-warriors: volunteers of all ages take on the rocky shoreline at Tsing Lung Tau 💪🎒
2025-09-06.enBody:
On 6 September 2025 our environmental volunteers were out again, this time taking on the demanding shoreline at Tsing Lung Tau.

The most eye-catching addition to the team that day was a very bright, very determined young volunteer who came along with his father to join in. The Tsing Lung Tau shoreline is covered in rock and the ground is uneven — a real test of stamina and eyesight for volunteers of any age.

Nobody was daunted. On arrival the team kitted up and divided the work. Our youngest volunteer moved nimbly between the rocks with a small picker, hunting out hidden plastic bottles, discarded fishing net and broken glass, while the adults handled the heavier items. Young and old worked in step. The sea wind was strong and the sweat kept coming, but the youngest member never once complained — if anything he got more determined as he went, and by the time the beach was clean he was visibly proud of himself. It was as good a lesson in looking after the environment as anyone could have.

After most of a day of hard work on hands and feet, we cleared 10 bags of waste from that rocky shore and gave a stretch of coast back to nature. The cheer that went up for the group photo around the haul said it all.

Our respect to every volunteer who took on that terrain without complaint — and particular credit to our volunteers young and old who were on outstanding form. Thank you for passing something on. 💙

2025-09-06.scTitle: 环保小战士进击！青龙头海岸线大减废，大小义工无惧崎岖石滩齐心守护海洋 💪🎒

2025-09-06.scBody:
喺2025年9月6日，乐桥义工大队嘅绿色减废大军再度出动，今次我哋进击环境极具挑战性嘅青龙头海岸线，展开一场热血爆灯嘅净滩大作战！而今日最令人振奋、目光最吸睛嘅，莫过于我哋嘅队伍中多了一个超精灵、超有干劲嘅小义工伙伴，跟住爸爸一齐身体力行加入环保行列！青龙头嘅海岸线布满岩石，地形崎岖不平，对大小朋友嚟讲绝对系一场体能与眼力嘅大考验。

但大家完全冇喺怕！一到现场，大小义工即刻分工合作、全副武装，化身成最强嘅「海洋守护者」。小义工化身「环保小战士」，灵活咁喺石缝间穿梭，用小夹子细心搜寻隐藏嘅塑胶樽、废弃渔网同碎玻璃；而大义工们就负责搬运沉甸甸嘅大件垃圾，老少协力，默契爆棚！虽然当日海风大、汗水不断流，但小朋友完全冇叫辛苦，反而愈执愈起劲，见到海滩回复干净，个个脸上都洋溢著无比自豪嘅笑容，完美上了一堂最珍贵嘅实地环保课！

经过大家大半日嘅挥汗努力、手脚并用，我哋成功喺崎岖嘅石滩中清理出10袋危害海洋生态嘅垃圾，还大自然一片洁净嘅海岸！看到大家战绩彪炳、围住垃圾大合照𠮶一刻，现场嘅欢呼声同成就感直接拉到最满！在这里要向当日每一位无惧地形崎岖、不辞劳苦嘅大爱义工致敬——特别要大赞一班表现超班、活力爆棚嘅大小义工！多谢你哋用汗水与行动，将爱护地球嘅种子传承落去！💙

2025-09-13.enTitle: Kwu Tung turns out: LucaBridge joins the Hong Kong Paper Crafting Association, with celebrity volunteers Yip Hoi-yan, Yan Chin-man and Cheung Pak-man, and thanks to The Garden Company and our donors 🌟🍞
2025-09-13.enBody:
On 13 September 2025 our volunteer team joined the Hong Kong Paper Crafting Association for a care package distribution in Kwu Tung, with a line-up and a level of warmth that were both hard to beat.

This one brought together goodwill from several directions. Our particular thanks to The Garden Company for generously donating a large quantity of fresh bread, and to the individual donors who supplied biscuits, which meant our packages were genuinely well filled. The other surprise for the residents of Kwu Tung was the arrival of three well-known volunteers — Yip Hoi-yan, Yan Chin-man and Cheung Pak-man — who came to help in person.

All three got straight to work alongside the LucaBridge and Paper Crafting Association volunteers, without a hint of ceremony. The elderly residents and neighbours of Kwu Tung lit up on seeing them. The three were attentive throughout, handing 150 heavy packages of Garden bread, donated biscuits and health items directly into people's hands, shaking hands and offering warm greetings as they went. The laughter carried, and the mood in Kwu Tung went up several degrees.

Watching residents head home with full bags and satisfied, reassured faces, every volunteer there knew the effort had been worth it.

Our sincere thanks once more to the Hong Kong Paper Crafting Association for joining forces with us, to The Garden Company and our individual donors for their generosity, and to Yip Hoi-yan, Yan Chin-man and Cheung Pak-man for giving their time. And of course to the LucaBridge volunteers who turn out in all weather. 🔥🎒🌟

2025-09-14.enTitle: A promise kept: back at On Sum Kui with more care packages and donated medical supplies 🩺😷
2025-09-14.enVenue: On Sum Kui Home for the Elderly, Yuen Long — return visit
2025-09-14.enBody:
Our volunteers were back in Yuen Long. On 14 September 2025 we kept our promise and returned to On Sum Kui Home for the Elderly.

It had been barely a month since our last visit, and the moment we walked in, the residents and staff recognised us. The welcome was immediate and loud. This time we came better equipped. As well as handing 150 care packages of everyday health essentials to each resident and staying to talk, we thought about what the home would need longer term, and donated a supply of high-grade masks and accurate thermometers for the home to use directly.

The intention was practical: to support the health of both the residents and the frontline care staff, starting with everyday protection and monitoring. The mood was part reunion, part something warmer. Volunteers sat with residents and listened to what had happened in the month since we were last there. Watching the residents take their packages with those reassured, contented smiles, holding on to the volunteers' hands and saying "back to see us again so soon", took the tiredness out of a day of carrying boxes.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at On Sum Kui for their help and easy cooperation, and our deepest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who understands that showing up again matters more than showing up once.

Because of you, a promise carries weight. ✨👵👴💖

It had been barely a month since our last visit, and the moment we walked in, the residents and staff recognised us. The welcome was immediate and loud. This time we came better equipped.
2025-09-14.scTitle: 爱心重临，诺言实现！再访元朗安心居大派福袋，加码捐赠医疗物资，全方位守护老友记健康 🩺😷
2025-09-14.scVenue: 再访元朗安心居老人院送暖
2025-09-14.scBody:
乐桥义工大队嘅关爱步伐再次踩入元朗！喺2025年9月14日，我哋实践承诺，再度重临元朗安心居老人院！距离上次探访只系相隔短短一个月，当大家再次踏住院舍，一班老友记同职员一见到我哋呢班熟面孔，惊喜同欢呼声瞬间引爆全场，亲切感直接拉满！今次重临，我哋嘅爱心物资更加升级！除咗亲手将150袋装满日常健康必备品嘅暖心福袋送到每一位老友记手上，为佢哋解闷倾计之外，乐桥更考虑到院舍嘅长远需要，特别加码捐赠了一批高规格口罩同精准探热针物资给院舍直接使用！

希望用实质行动，从日常防护同健康监测开始，全方位守护一班长者同前线护理人员嘅健康。现场嘅气氛既有重逢嘅温馨，又有满满嘅人情味。义工们围喺老友记身边话家常，听佢哋分享呢一个月嚟嘅生活点滴。看著长者们接过福袋时露出慈祥、安心又满足嘅笑容，拉著义工嘅手舍不得放开，不停话「你哋咁快又嚟睇我哋喇」，那一刻嘅双向奔赴同感动，让每一位在场嘅热血义工都觉得甜入心坎，搬运物资嘅疲劳瞬间一扫而空！

在这里衷心感谢安心居老人院全体工作人员嘅全力协助与默契配合，亦要向当日每一位秉持住「长情与陪伴」、出汗出力嘅乐桥热血义工致以最崇高嘅敬意！因为有你哋，承诺变得有重量，乐桥继续同大家并肩同行，带著这份感动，让社区变得更有温度。✨👵👴💖

2025-09-21.enTitle: Into Prince Edward: an afternoon of company and laughter at Chung Ling Tak Fung Care Home 👵👴✨
2025-09-21.enVenue: Chung Ling Tak Fung Care Home, Prince Edward
2025-09-21.enBody:
On 21 September 2025 our volunteer team set out again, this time to Chung Ling Tak Fung Care Home in Prince Edward, for a visit built around company and good humour.

The moment we walked in, the volunteers greeted every resident warmly and by name where they could, and the quiet of the home gave way to something a good deal livelier. The work divided itself up, and gifts of good wishes and practical everyday items were handed to residents one by one.

For the residents, though, the gift that mattered was the volunteers' undivided attention. People gathered round, took the residents' hands, and listened to them talk about their lives. Laughter kept breaking out; some residents got so into it that they pulled volunteers into singing with them. Watching those faces open up into smiles you would call childlike, the sweat and the lifting stopped registering entirely.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Chung Ling Tak Fung Care Home for their help and thoughtful arrangements, which made the day run as well as it did, and our respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who brought endless patience to it. Because you came, these residents' days are warmer. Company is the longest declaration of care there is, and we are not stopping. See you at the next one.

The moment we walked in, the volunteers greeted every resident warmly and by name where they could, and the quiet of the home gave way to something a good deal livelier.
2025-09-21.scTitle: 爱心足迹进击太子！走入松龄德丰护老中心，暖心陪伴与欢笑声融化老友记心房 👵👴✨
2025-09-21.scVenue: 太子松龄德丰护老中心探访送暖行动
2025-09-21.scBody:
喺2025年9月21日，乐桥义工大队再次集结出发，今次我哋嘅热血送暖列车驶到咗位于太子嘅优质院舍——松龄德丰护老中心，为这里嘅长者们举办了一场充满欢乐与温情嘅探访活动！一踏住院舍，热血义工们个个打足十二分精神，用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音同各位老友记打招呼，现场沉静嘅气氛瞬间被我哋嘅活力点燃！大家分工合作，亲手将一份份满载祝福与实用日常物资嘅暖心礼物递到长者手中。

不过，对一班老友记嚟讲，最珍贵嘅礼物绝对系义工们毫无保留嘅真诚陪伴。大家自发围喺长者身边，化身成最贴心嘅「乖孙」，握住老人家温暖嘅双手听佢哋话当初、分享生活点滴。现场不断传出阵阵开怀嘅欢笑声，有啲老友记倾到兴起仲拉住义工一齐唱歌，温馨同融洽嘅画面直接将现场嘅幸福指数拉到最满！看到长者们脸上展露出如孩童般灿烂、舒心嘅笑容，那一刻，大家搬运物资嘅汗水同疲劳瞬间被彻底治愈！

在这里要衷心感谢松龄德丰护老中心全体职员嘅全力协助与贴心安排，令活动可以办得咁顺畅、咁有温度；更要向当日每一位付出无限耐心、用爱心灌溉社区嘅乐桥热血义工家人致敬！有你哋嘅同行，长者们嘅日子变得加倍温暖。陪伴是最长情的告白，乐桥关怀长者永不停步！让我们继续带著这份热诚，走向下一个需要温暖嘅地方，大家下一站再见！

2025-09-27.enTitle: A Mid-Autumn reunion at Sing Gor Bing Sutt: mooncakes and care packages for Shui Pin Wai 🥮✨
2025-09-27.enVenue: Sing Gor Bing Sutt, Shui Pin Wai — Mid-Autumn mooncake and care package distribution
2025-09-27.enBody:
Mid-Autumn is about being together, and we wanted to get there first. On 27 September 2025, with the festival approaching, our volunteer team headed to Sing Gor Bing Sutt in Shui Pin Wai, Yuen Long, for a mooncake and care package distribution with the festival firmly in mind.

The place was busy well before we started, with elderly residents arriving in anticipation. Our volunteers turned out in uniform and on good form, ready for the day.

Splitting the work between them, they handed over 150 boxes of mooncakes — the symbol of reunion — along with care packages of everyday health items, one at a time. "Happy Mid-Autumn! Wishing you good health!" The greetings carried across the bing sutt all afternoon.

The residents took their mooncakes and packages beaming, holding on to the volunteers' hands with praise for everyone. Watching those faces, as round and contented as the moon itself, the festival mood in Shui Pin Wai Estate could not have been higher.

A loud thank you to everyone at Sing Gor Bing Sutt for hosting us so well — because of your support this festival warmth reached the people it was meant for — and our deepest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who threw themselves into the day. We'll keep going.

On 27 September 2025, with the festival approaching, our volunteer team headed to Sing Gor Bing Sutt in Shui Pin Wai, Yuen Long, for a mooncake and care package distribution with the festival firmly in mind. The place was busy well before we started, with elderly residents arriving in anticipation.
2025-09-27.scTitle: 中秋人月两团圆！进击水边围盛哥冰室，应节月饼与暖心福袋大派发，点亮街坊笑脸 🥮✨
2025-09-27.scVenue: 水边围盛哥冰室中秋福袋月饼大派送
2025-09-27.scBody:
中秋佳节人团圆，乐桥送暖最走前！喺2025年9月27日，适逢中秋佳节即将到来，乐桥义工大队嘅热血步伐驶进了元朗水边围盛哥冰室，为这里嘅街坊长者们举办了一场充满节日气氛、窝心指数爆灯嘅中秋月饼福袋派发活动！当日现场一早已经人头涌涌，一众老友记满怀期待咁前来支持。我哋嘅热血义工队伍个个身穿醒目制服、打足十二分精神，化身成最强嘅「中秋福气大使」！

大家分工合作，亲手将150盒象征团圆与祝福嘅中秋月饼，连同装满日常健康物资嘅暖心福袋，一个接一个咁递到街坊手上。「长者们，中秋快乐！祝你哋身体健康呀！」一声声响亮又亲切嘅问候，伴随著热腾腾嘅节日祝福，在盛哥冰室内此起彼落。老友记们接过月饼同福袋，个个笑逐颜开、甜到入心，拉住义工嘅手赞不绝口。看到街坊们脸上展露出如月亮般圆满、幸福嘅笑容，现场满溢嘅人情味，直接将水边围邨嘅过节气氛推向最高点！

在这里要大声感谢盛哥冰室嘅全体上下同埋场地完美配合，因为有你哋嘅大力支持，我哋先可以将呢份节日温暖直送街坊心坎里；更要向当日全情投入、出汗出力嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！中秋送暖，爱不停步！乐桥会继续带著呢份热诚同正能量，走向更多需要温暖嘅角落。

2025-10-01.enTitle: National Day in Wang Toi Shan: mooncakes and care packages at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly, with thanks to Wai Kee Trading 🥮✨
2025-10-01.enVenue: Yan Wo Home for the Elderly, Wang Toi Shan — National Day and Mid-Autumn outreach
2025-10-01.enBody:
A day of national celebration, and a day for kindness. On 1 October 2025 our volunteer team was out in force at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly in Wang Toi Shan, for a National Day distribution of care packages and Mid-Autumn mooncakes.

Our particular thanks to Wai Kee Transport Company Limited for their generous sponsorship. Because of their support we were able to prepare 20 boxes of good festival mooncakes, delivered to the home by Wai Kee themselves, so that every resident could have a taste of the season.

With National Day falling that day, the whole home was in a celebratory mood. Our volunteers arrived in uniform and on top form, greeting every resident warmly. The work divided itself up, and boxes of mooncakes together with care packages of practical health items went to each resident in person. "Happy National Day! Wishing you good health and good spirits!" The greetings, and the time spent sitting with people, did the rest.

Watching the residents take their mooncakes and packages with those bright, easy smiles, holding volunteers' hands and talking at length about the old days, the feeling in that room went right to the top. However much lifting the volunteers had done, they left full of it.

Our sincere thanks again to Wai Kee Trading Company Limited for their generosity, to all the staff at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly for their help, and to every LucaBridge volunteer who gave up a public holiday to be there.

Because of you, this National Day meant a good deal more. 🔥🎒🥮

On 1 October 2025 our volunteer team was out in force at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly in Wang Toi Shan, for a National Day distribution of care packages and Mid-Autumn mooncakes. Our particular thanks to Wai Kee Transport Company Limited for their generous sponsorship.
2025-10-01.scTitle: 国庆大日子，爱心满新村！横台山恩和安老院福袋月饼大派送，特别鸣谢炜记贸易有限公司热血赞助 🥮✨
2025-10-01.scVenue: 横台山新村恩和安老院国庆中秋送暖行动
2025-10-01.scBody:
普天同庆，善心并行！喺2025年10月1日国庆佳节呢个充满喜庆同自豪嘅大日子，乐桥义工大队完全冇停落嚟，反而以最热烈嘅姿态出动，进击位于横台山新村嘅恩和安老院，展开了一场既具节日气氛、又温馨感人嘅福袋与中秋月饼大派送行动！今次活动得以顺利举行，要**特别鸣谢「炜记运输有限公司」**嘅无私大爱赞助！因为有你哋嘅强力支持，我哋得以备齐20盒精美应节月饼，由炜记贸易化身爱心战车直送院舍，确保每一位老友记都可以品尝到这份浓浓嘅节日甜意！

当日适逢国庆，成个院舍都洋溢著喜气洋洋嘅气氛。我哋嘅热血义工队伍著住整齐醒目嘅制服，打足十二分精神步入院舍，用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音同各位老友记问好。大家分工合作，亲手将一盒盒象征团圆嘅美味月饼，连同装满实用健康物资嘅暖心福袋，送到每一位长者手上！「老友记，国庆快乐！祝你哋身体健康、开开心心！」义工们贴心嘅问候，伴随着真挚嘅陪伴，瞬间融化咗长者们嘅心房。

看到老人家接过月饼同福袋时，脸上展露出如孩童般灿烂、舒心嘅笑容，拉住义工嘅手滔滔不绝咁话当初，那一刻现场交织嘅人情味同幸福感，直接冲破顶点！全场义工就算搬到流晒大汗，内心都觉得无比充实同自豪！在这里再次衷心感谢炜记贸易有限公司嘅慷慨赞助、恩和安老院全体职员嘅全力协助，以及当日舍弃假期、身体力行过嚟出汗出力嘅乐桥热血义工家人！

因为有你哋，呢个国庆日变得格外温暖、分外有意义！国庆送暖，大爱无疆！乐桥不停步，我们带著这份澎湃嘅正能量，继续走向下一个需要温暖嘅角落！🔥🎒🥮

2025-10-02.enTitle: Two festivals, one afternoon: hot meal boxes and care packages at Wah Yuen Noodles, with thanks to the Lung family 🥮🍱✨
2025-10-02.enVenue: Wah Yuen Noodles, Yuen Long — double festival outreach
2025-10-02.enBody:
Straight on from the day before. On 2 October 2025, in the middle of the National Day and Mid-Autumn period, our volunteers assembled again — this time back at Wah Yuen Noodles in Yuen Long, for a large distribution of meals, care packages and mooncakes.

Two days of this in a row was possible thanks once again to the Lung family's continued sponsorship. With their backing, a steady supply of good festival mooncakes reached the front line, which meant our care packages went out heavier and better than planned, and the residents of Yuen Long got a double helping of the season.

A queue formed outside Wah Yuen Noodles early that afternoon, residents and elderly neighbours in good spirits. Our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight into it, forming a very efficient line. Between them they handed over 150 hot meal boxes prepared by Wah Yuen Noodles, along with the mooncakes sponsored by Wai Kee Trading and care packages of health items, to each person who came.

"Happy Mid-Autumn and happy National Day! Get a hot meal in you — and stay well!" The greetings kept the laughter going across the whole neighbourhood. Watching the satisfaction on people's faces as they took a hot meal and a mooncake, and hearing "thank you LucaBridge, thank you everyone" over and over, our volunteers — arms aching, thoroughly sweaty — were flying.

A loud thank you to the Lung family for their generosity and to Wah Yuen Noodles for their full support and for preparing the food, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who gave up two consecutive days of holiday to be there.

Because you keep at it, the festivals here have some warmth to them. October is only getting started. 🔥🎒🥮🍱

Two days of this in a row was possible thanks once again to the Lung family's continued sponsorship.
2025-10-02.scTitle: 双节狂欢，爱心连线！华苑粉面午后大送暖，热腾腾爱心饭盒与福袋满载街坊情，全体激赞龙氏家族 🥮🍱✨
2025-10-02.scVenue: 元朗华苑粉面双节送暖行动
2025-10-02.scBody:
爱心接力，热血不停歇！紧接住前一日嘅精彩行动，喺2025年10月2日国庆与中秋双节期间，乐桥义工大队再次吹响集结号！今次我哋嘅热血步伐重临元朗华苑粉面，开展了一场规模宏大、香气四溢兼且人情味爆棚嘅派饭、派福袋兼派月饼大行动！今次活动能够连续引爆正能量，必须**再度特别鸣谢「龙氏家族」嘅持续大爱赞助！

因为有你哋嘅全力撑腰，大批高质素嘅应节月饼源源不绝咁送到前线，等我哋嘅暖心福袋分量加码、诚意爆灯，让元朗街坊喺节日氛围下感受到双重嘅甜蜜与温饱！当日下昼嘅华苑粉面门口早早就排起咗长龙，街坊同老友记们个个精神抖擞。我哋著住整齐制服嘅热血义工队伍一到场就火力全开，分工合作化身成最有效率嘅爱心传递线！大家亲手将150盒由华苑粉面用心制作、热腾腾嘅爱心饭盒，连同炜记贸易赞助嘅应节月饼以及装满健康物资嘅福袋，亲手递到每一位街坊手上。

「中秋国庆快乐！食餐热辣辣嘅靓饭，祝你身体健康！」义工们一声声响亮、热情嘅节日问候，让整个社区都充满了欢笑声。看到老友记们接过爱心饭盒同月饼时，脸上展露出嘅满足笑容，听著那一声声真挚嘅「多谢乐桥、多谢大家」，全场义工就算搬运搬到手软、流晒大汗，内心都觉得热血沸腾，成就感直接冲破天际！在这里要大声感谢龙氏家族嘅慷慨解囊、华苑粉面嘅全力支持与美食准备，更要向连续两日放弃假期、出汗出力、持之以恒嘅乐桥热血义工家人们致以最崇高嘅敬意！

因为有你哋每一步嘅坚持，社区嘅节日色彩先可以咁温暖、咁闪亮！节日送暖，大爱承传！十月份嘅奇迹才刚开始，我们继续带著呢份澎湃嘅正能量，走向更多需要温暖嘅地方！🔥🎒🥮🍱

2025-10-04.enTitle: The festival warmth continues: mooncakes and care packages at Lung Hei 🥮✨
2025-10-04.enVenue: Lung Hei Mid-Autumn mooncake and care package distribution
2025-10-04.enBody:
Mid-Autumn has passed, but the warmth has not. On 4 October 2025 our volunteer team was back at Lung Hei.

We were determined to carry the festival right to the end, so we came with well-filled care packages of everyday health items and festival mooncakes to go with them — a weekend Mid-Autumn greeting for the neighbourhood. The turnout was as strong as ever, with elderly residents queuing early in anticipation.

Our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight to work — moving supplies, laying out packages, keeping the queue moving — with the kind of coordination that only comes from practice. As they handed over 300 care packages and the mooncakes that go with the season, with a warm "may every day be as good as Mid-Autumn, and stay well", the easy smiles that came back were the best return this team could ask for. Watching the elderly residents holding their mooncakes and packages, happily talking about times past, the whole place felt good to be in.

Our sincere thanks to Lung Hei for their full support and for hosting us so well, and full credit to every LucaBridge volunteer who worked hard all day and smiled through it.

Because you keep turning up, this keeps going. 🔥🎒🥮🍱

2025-10-12.enTitle: A new partner in Yuen Long: our first outing with Tai Fung Sau Cha Chaan Teng, serving meal boxes and care packages 🍱🌾✨
2025-10-12.enVenue: Tai Fung Sau Cha Chaan Teng, Yuen Long
2025-10-12.enBody:
A milestone of a day. On 12 October 2025 our volunteers arrived somewhere new, working for the first time with Tai Fung Sau Cha Chaan Teng in Yuen Long. The restaurant's name means "a great harvest", and that was exactly the intention: a good harvest for the residents of Yuen Long, in food and in spirits alike.

For a first collaboration the atmosphere was excellent. Everyone at Tai Fung Sau went all in, carefully preparing 100 hot, fragrant meal boxes, while LucaBridge brought care packages of health items and everyday essentials — between us, a proper injection of weekend goodwill into the neighbourhood.

Word that this was our first outing together brought people out early, and a queue formed well before we began. Our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight into it — moving supplies, portioning meal boxes, keeping order — working with the restaurant's staff as if they had done it many times before.

When the volunteers handed a hot meal and a well-filled care package to each elderly resident with a warm greeting, the surprise and relief on people's faces was the best verdict on our debut we could have had. Watching a whole neighbourhood fill with laughter because we turned up, the aching arms stopped mattering.

Our most sincere thanks to the owner and all the staff of Tai Fung Sau Cha Chaan Teng for their support and their perfect cooperation, which began something worth continuing. And full credit to the LucaBridge volunteers who worked through it without complaint.

A new start, and a good harvest. This first outing is only the beginning. 🔥🎒🍱✨

2025-10-12-2.enTitle: Cards on the table again: the Din Din House league returns, with prizes generously backed by yumeno_card and palette2ptcg 🔥🏆✨
2025-10-12-2.enVenue: Din Din House card game league, Hung Hom
2025-10-12-2.enBody:
Two fronts in one day. On 12 October 2025 our volunteers were not only in Yuen Long — a second group returned to Din Din House in Hung Hom for a card game tournament players had been waiting for.

That this event stepped up in scale, drawing top players and a good deal of attention, is down to yumeno_card and palette2ptcg, who backed it with a generous haul of prizes. The quality of what was on the table sent everyone's competitive instincts straight up.

On the day, Din Din House was full before we started, with strong players everywhere. Our volunteers, in uniform, handled registration, kept things orderly and got the room going. When the judge gave the word, play began. All 34 competitors settled in, thinking fast and planning several moves ahead, and one tactical duel after another played out across the tables.

Every spectacular draw and every comeback brought the room down. The best of it, of course, was the prize-giving: watching the winners take the prizes sponsored by yumeno_card and palette2ptcg, proud and thrilled, and the group photo afterwards where everyone who had lost looked just as pleased to have been there.

Cards carry ambition, and a tournament builds friendships. Through this event, focus, teamwork and a good deal of positive energy reached a lot more young people.

Our sincere thanks again to Din Din House for the venue, to yumeno_card and palette2ptcg for their generous sponsorship, and to every competitor who gave it everything, along with the LucaBridge volunteers who made it run.

Whether it is a community distribution or a competitive card tournament, if there is a need, we will be there. 💪🔥🃏🎒

2025-10-18.enTitle: 400 care packages for Fu Shin Estate, Tai Po — delivered door to door to elderly residents living alone, alongside our celebrity volunteers 👵❤
2025-10-18.enBody:
On 18 October 2025 our volunteers went to Fu Shin Estate in Tai Po and, together with the Jui Sin Volunteer Group, ran a care package distribution — 400 packages of practical supplies in total.

We were very glad to have celebrity volunteers Yan Chin-man, Tsang Man-sum and Sandra with us on the day. With their support the mood was warm and easy, and the residents and elderly neighbours who came were visibly pleased.

As well as the distribution point itself, we made separate arrangements for elderly residents with limited mobility and those living alone: a team of volunteers took 30 of the packages to people's homes and delivered them in person.

Along with the supplies, the volunteers asked in detail about how people were managing day to day and how their health was, bringing the care right to the door.

Our thanks to the Jui Sin Volunteer Group for working so closely with us, and to our three celebrity volunteers for giving their time. LucaBridge will keep working in this community, and keep putting into practice the idea that one life can reach another. 🌱✨

2025-10-25.enTitle: Kindness passed down: rice and care packages at Phone Factory, Yuen Long, with two of our youngest volunteers leading the way 🌾👦👧✨
2025-10-25.enVenue: Phone Factory, Yuen Long — rice and care package distribution
2025-10-25.enBody:
On 25 October 2025 our volunteers were back at Phone Factory in Yuen Long for a distribution of rice and care packages — and the day belonged, without question, to two young volunteers joining us for the first time.

The rice and the care packages were stacked and ready when we arrived. The loads were heavy, but our two youngest helpers were not remotely put off. The moment they had their uniforms on they were straight into it.

Working alongside the adults, they passed supplies along, helped keep the queue in order, and handed 150 care packages to the elderly residents who came — with a level of commitment you would struggle to fault. The residents of Yuen Long could not believe how well-mannered and willing these two were, and the whole place warmed up. In the clearest voices they could manage, the children offered their good wishes: "Grandad, grandma, wishing you good health!"

That greeting, arriving with a bag of rice, went straight through everyone there. The elderly residents beamed, took the children's hands and praised them to anyone who would listen — "such a good boy, such a good girl, out doing good at that age, what a blessing." Watching residents head home with full bags and easy faces, and then watching two children soaked with sweat and still grinning, got to every volunteer present.

This was more than a distribution; it was about as good a lesson in kindness as a child could be given. Our sincere thanks to Phone Factory for their full support and for hosting us, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who gave everything on the day — and to our two remarkable young volunteers and their parents. Thank you for planting something in this community. 🔥🎒🌾
2025-10-25.enSummary: On 25 October 2025 our volunteers were back at Phone Factory in Yuen Long for a distribution of rice and care packages — and the day belonged, without question, to two young volunteers joining us for the first time. The rice and the care packages were stacked and ready when we arrived. The loads were heavy, but our two youngest helpers were not remotely put off.
2025-10-25.scTitle: 爱心承传，萌爆元朗！重临phone工场爆量派米送福袋，两位最强「小义工」跨代合力，温暖融化街坊心房 🌾👦👧✨
2025-10-25.scVenue: 元朗phone工场派米及福袋行动
2025-10-25.scBody:
爱心薪火相传，热血永不停歇！喺2025年10月25日，乐桥义工大队嘅送暖列车再次驶入元朗phone工场，展开了一场既震撼、又充满童趣温馨嘅派米同暖心福袋大行动！而今日全场嘅焦点与掌声，无疑全部聚焦喺两位首度加入、表现超级超班嘅小朋友义工身上！一到现场，堆积如山嘅爱心白米同沉甸甸嘅福袋已经准备就绪。虽然物资非常有分量，但我哋呢两位年纪细细嘅「爱心小战士」完全冇喺怕，一穿上制服就即刻化身最强小助手！

佢哋跟住大义工们分工合作，用一对对稚嫩却坚定嘅小手，帮忙传递物资、维持秩序，甚至亲手将150份福袋递给前来嘅老友记，干劲十足，专业度直接拉满！元朗嘅街坊同老友记们一见到两位咁乖巧、咁有爱心嘅小朋友，个个惊喜万分，现场嘅亲切感同欢笑声瞬间引爆！小朋友们用最纯真、最响亮嘅声音送上祝福：「爷爷嫲嫲，祝你哋身体健康！」

呢一声声直击心坎嘅问候，伴随着热腾腾嘅白米，直接融化咗在场所有长者嘅心。老友记们个个笑逐颜开，拉住小义工嘅手赞不绝口，纷纷大赞「真系乖仔/乖女，咁细个就出嚟做善事，好福气！」现场温馨嘅人情味直接冲破顶点！看著街坊们满载而归、脸上流露出满足与安心嘅笑容，再看著两位流晒大汗却依然笑得灿烂嘅小朋友，现场每一位义工伙伴都觉得感动无比！

这不单止是一场送暖活动，更是一场最完美、最珍贵嘅实地身教与大爱传承。在这里要衷心感谢phone工场嘅全力支持与场地配合，更要向当日全情投入、出汗出力嘅乐桥义工家人，以及两位表现惊艳、活力爆棚嘅小义工宝贝与家长致以最崇高嘅敬意！多谢你哋用行动，将善良嘅种子播撒进社区。大爱无界，承传不息！乐桥不停步，让我们带住呢份满满嘅感动与正能量，继续并肩前行！🔥🎒🌾

2025-11-15.enTitle: Groundwork first: registration opens at Tin Yan Estate, Tin Shui Wai, as volunteers sign residents up one by one ✨
2025-11-15.enVenue: Tin Yan Estate care package registration, Tin Shui Wai
2025-11-15.enBody:
Getting the groundwork right. On 15 November 2025 our volunteer team headed into Tin Shui Wai, to Tin Yan Estate, to begin registration for the distribution to come.

This was more than an administrative exercise — it was our first proper contact with the residents of Tin Yan Estate. A large group of elderly residents and neighbours were queuing to ask questions well before we started. Our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight to it: setting up the registration desk, keeping the queue orderly, preparing forms, all of it running smoothly.

Faced with a long line of elderly residents, the volunteers gave it every ounce of patience they had. Some residents could not see well or were not comfortable with forms, so the volunteers crouched down beside them, took their hands and worked through the details line by line, then explained exactly when and where the packages could be collected. "No rush at all, take your time, I'll fill it in for you. Look after yourself — we'll be back with your package before you know it."

That kind of reassurance carried across Tin Yan Estate all day. Residents watched volunteers work themselves into a sweat and still stay patient and attentive, and the trust in their faces said everything.

Our sincere thanks to everyone at Tin Yan Estate for their full support and for hosting us so well, and full credit to the LucaBridge volunteers who gave their time and looked after every resident properly.

Because you got the front end right, what comes next has a solid footing. Registration complete — now we prepare for the distribution. 🔥📋🎁✨

This was more than an administrative exercise — it was our first proper contact with the residents of Tin Yan Estate.
2025-11-15.scTitle: 爱心前哨战，精准送暖！天水围天恩邨福袋活动登记火热展开，热血义工细心点对点为街坊登记幸福大爱启航 ✨
2025-11-15.scVenue: 天水围天恩邨福袋活动登记
2025-11-15.scBody:
把关最前线，细心显大爱！喺2025年11月15日，乐桥义工大队浩浩荡荡进击天水围，走入充满街坊情怀嘅天恩邨，正式为即将到来嘅大派送展开极具意义嘅福袋活动登记工作！呢个「前哨战」不单止是一场登记，更加是我们与天恩邨街坊们建立温暖连结嘅第一步！当日现场一早已经有大批老友记同街坊满怀期待咁前来排队查询。我哋著住醒目制服嘅热血义工队伍一到场就即刻火力全开，设置登记站、维持秩序、准备表格，分工合作展现超强默契与专业！

面对众多位前来登记嘅长者，义工们个个拿出咗百分之百嘅耐心同爱心。因为部分老友记视力不好或者不擅长填表，我哋嘅义工随即化身成最贴心嘅「私人秘书」，主动蹲下身子、握住长者嘅手，一字一句、细心温柔咁协助佢哋填写资料，并详细讲解日后领取福袋嘅时间同地点。「爷爷嫲嫲，唔使急，慢慢嚟，我帮你填！记住保重身体，我哋好快又会过嚟派福袋畀你哋喇！」

一声声响亮、亲切又真挚嘅叮嘱，在天恩邨内此起彼落。街坊们看著义工们忙到流晒大汗，却依然笑容满面、细致入微，个个赞不绝口，眼神里满是信任与安心。那一刻，整个登记现场被满满嘅人情味与温馨氛围彻底包围，幸福感直接拉爆！在这里要衷心感谢天水围天恩邨相关单位嘅全力支持与场地完美配合，更加要大赞当日全情投入、出汗出力、用极致细心守护街坊嘅乐桥热血义工家人！

因为有你哋在第一线嘅把关与付出，接下来嘅送暖行动先可以办得咁有底气、咁有温度！细节成就大爱，乐桥送暖不停步！登记工作圆满达成，我们带著这份澎湃嘅正能量，全力筹备接下来嘅大派送！🔥📋🎁✨

2025-11-19.enTitle: Full speed at Tin Wah Estate: registration opens as we count down to the 22 November distribution 💪🎁✨
2025-11-19.enVenue: Tin Wah Estate, Tin Shui Wai
2025-11-19.enBody:
Round two of the groundwork. On 19 November 2025 our volunteers moved straight on to Tin Wah Estate in Tin Shui Wai to open registration for the 22 November distribution, working on the principle that nobody gets left off the list.

Registration only, in theory — but the residents of Tin Wah Estate turned out in force, and a queue formed early. Our volunteers arrived in uniform and went straight into it: directing people, checking details, filling in forms, keeping order, all of it flowing.

With elderly residents coming through steadily, the volunteers became something closer to personal secretaries. Where a resident could not hear well or could not read, a volunteer would move in close and work through it in clear, gentle Cantonese, word by word, until the paperwork was done.

"No need to rush — you're all registered. Come back on the 22nd for your package and we'll see you then." That kind of warmth turned a cold November day into something else entirely. Residents watching volunteers stay meticulous while working up a sweat gave LucaBridge a firm thumbs up for being both thoughtful and efficient. Tin Wah Estate spent the day full of anticipation.

Our sincere thanks to the team at Tin Wah Estate for their help and for hosting us so well, and our respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who served these residents with complete attention.

Registration done and everyone ready. Next stop, 22 November. 📋🎒🎁✨

2025-11-19.scTitle: 全速推进，爱心连线！天华邨福袋登记火热开跑，热血义工全力总动员，携手街坊倒数迎11.22大送暖 💪🎁✨
2025-11-19.scBody:
爱心前哨第二弹，热血进击天华邨！喺2025年11月19日，乐桥义工大队马不停蹄，将送暖列车驶进天水围天华邨，正式打响11月22日福袋大派送嘅大登记战役！我哋秉持住「一个都不能少」嘅服务精神，要在最前线为街坊们把关，将幸福名单逐一确认！虽然当日只系登记活动，但天华邨嘅街坊同老友记一早就展现出超强嘅热情，现场早早排起了长龙。

我哋著住整齐制服嘅热血义工队伍一到场，即刻以最饱满嘅精神状态投入战斗！分流、对资料、填表格、维持秩序，成个流程行云流水，默契直接拉到最满！面对前来登记嘅长者，义工们化身成最贴心、最精明嘅「爱心书记」。遇到有老友记听力唔好、或者唔识字，我哋嘅热血义工即刻主动挨近，用最宏亮、最温柔嘅广东话一字一句同长者沟通，耐心帮佢哋完成手续。

「长者们唔使赶、唔使急，登记好喇！记住22号过嚟攞福袋，我哋到时见！」一声声热情嘅叮嘱同温暖嘅笑容，让寒冷嘅十一月天瞬间充满了夏日般嘅温度。街坊们见到义工们忙到出晒大汗都依然细心无比，纷纷竖起大拇指大赞乐桥贴心又高效率！那一刻，整个天华邨都洋溢著满满嘅期盼与人情味，幸福感直接引爆！在这里要衷心感谢天水围天华邨相关团队嘅全力协助与场地完美配合，更加要向当日全情投入、出汗出力、用百分百细心服务街坊嘅乐桥热血义工家人致敬！

精准把关，蓄势待发！天华邨登记工作圆满达成，大家已经准备就绪，全力冲刺11月22日嘅福袋大派发，大家下一站（22号）顶峰相见！📋🎒🎁✨

2025-11-22.enTitle: First stop, Tin Yan Estate: a large turnout of volunteers, children included, with elderly residents served first 👵❤
2025-11-22.enBody:
On 22 November 2025 LucaBridge's outreach reached a new stop. The team went first to Tin Yan Estate, prioritising the elderly residents there and getting practical support to the households that needed it.

The mood on the day was excellent. Alongside a large turnout of volunteers, a good number of children volunteered too. Working together, volunteers of all ages helped count supplies, direct the queue and hand packages to the elderly residents themselves — a genuinely good example of generations working side by side.

Looking after elderly residents first has always been how LucaBridge works. Watching the relief on people's faces as they took their supplies, and watching the children learn what it means to give something, made the day feel worthwhile to everyone involved.

Our sincere thanks to every volunteer who threw themselves into it, and to each of our bright, well-behaved young volunteers. With you alongside us, this community is a warmer place. 🌱✨

2025-11-22.scTitle: 天恩邨首站送暖！大批热心义工与小朋友义工齐心上阵，优先为长者派发爱心物资 👵❤
2025-11-22.scBody:
于2025年11月22日，乐桥送暖活动开展全新一站。当日团队首先前往天恩邨，将准备好的爱心物资优先派发给当地的长者，为有需要的家庭送上实质支持。活动现场气氛热烈，当日除了有大批热心义工出席协助外，更有不少小朋友义工一同参与。一众大小义工分工合作，落手落脚协助物资盘点、人流引导及亲手将福袋传递到长者手中，展现出良好的跨代共融精神。

优先照顾长者是乐桥一贯的服务宗旨。看到老友记们接过物资时露出的舒心笑容，以及小朋友义工在服务中学习付出，大家都感到非常有意义。衷心感谢当日全情投入、出汗出力的大批义工以及每一位精灵懂事的小朋友义工。有你们的同行，让社区变得更加温暖！🌱✨

2025-11-26.enTitle: Fire at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po: LucaBridge and ten partner businesses mobilise a supply line within hours 💪🎒✨
2025-11-26.enVenue: Wang Fuk Court fire — emergency response and thanks to our partners
2025-11-26.enBody:
When one part of the city is in trouble, the rest of it turns up. On 26 November 2025 a fire broke out at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po. Our volunteer team activated its emergency response immediately and headed to the scene.

Behind our volunteers stood a group of businesses who backed us without hesitation, assembling 46 cases of water, 12 cases of Garden cakes and eight cases of Vitasoy in very short order and sending them straight to the site, for the affected residents and for the emergency crews working there.

Our most heartfelt thanks, from all our volunteers and from the residents affected, to the following organisations for their generosity (in no particular order): Wah Sao Bing Sutt, Kai Kee Store ⚓ Lik Sang Ho, Wong Sun Kee Chicken and Duck, Wai Kee Trading Company Limited, Lui's Drainage Engineering Company Limited, Cheuk Wang Trading Company Limited, AEON Tsuen Wan, and Kwong Sai Kei Logistics Company Limited.

Thank you for reaching into your pockets when the clock was against everyone. With food and drink from the bing sutt, the store and the shops, and with vehicles and logistics from the trading, transport and engineering companies, our volunteers were able to keep supplies moving into the hands of people who badly needed them.

The wind that night was bitter. But as residents took hot supplies and saw the line of support that LucaBridge and these businesses had put together, the reassurance in their faces cut through the worst of it. That safety net, woven from a dozen different directions, is Hong Kong at its best.

Thank you again to every one of these organisations, and to the LucaBridge volunteers who went straight to the scene the moment word came through and worked through the smoke without a word of complaint.

With all of you behind us, no situation is too big. 🔥🚨🎒❤
2025-11-26.enSummary: When one part of the city is in trouble, the rest of it turns up. On 26 November 2025 a fire broke out at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po. Our volunteer team activated its emergency response immediately and headed to the scene.
2025-11-26.scTitle: 水火无情，人间有爱！大埔宏福苑火灾无惧逆境，乐桥义工大队联同十大星级商号极速应援，筑起最强物资防线 💪🎒✨
2025-11-26.scVenue: 大埔宏福苑火灾突发支援・特别鸣谢篇
2025-11-26.scBody:
一方有难，八方支援！喺2025年11月26日，大埔宏福苑不幸发生突发火灾。面对危急灾情，乐桥义工大队上下一心，二话不说即刻启动紧急应援机制，全军奔赴前线支援。而在我们热血身影嘅背后，更加有一班顶级义气、爱心爆棚嘅「星级企业与商号」喺大后方倾力撑腰，喺最短时间内筹集46箱水，嘉顿蛋糕12箱，维他奶八箱，并直送灾场，为受影响街坊同前线救援人员送上最合时、最温暖嘅后援！

在这里，乐桥全体义工与受灾街坊要致以最崇高、最震撼、最真挚嘅谢意，特别鸣谢以下各大鼎力赞助物资、无私奉献嘅热心单位（排名不分先后）：华嫂冰室佳记士多 ⚓ 力生号黄燊记鸡鸭炜记贸易有限公司吕氏渠务工程有限公司卓宏贸易有限公司荃湾AEON旷世纪物流有限公司多谢你哋喺生死时速嘅关头慷慨解囊、出钱出力！有冰室、士多同名店嘅粮食饮品应援，有各大贸易、物流同工程公司嘅车队与物资调配，先可以等我哋一班前线义工著住整齐制服，底气十足、源源不绝咁将物资送到徬徨嘅街坊手中。

当晚灾场寒风刺骨，但当街坊们接过热腾腾嘅物资、见到乐桥同各大商号联手组成的应援防线时，眼神里流露出嘅安心与信任，直接冲破了火灾嘅阴霾！这一份由各界携手编织嘅安全网，就是香港人「狮子山下」同舟共济、风雨同路嘅最好见证！灾难虽然无情，但你哋嘅大爱比火更热、比光更亮！再次大声感谢以上所有大爱单位嘅热血相助，以及当日收到消息就第一时间冲上前线、顶住浓烟同大汗默默付出嘅乐桥热血义工家人！

危难见真情，乐桥永同行！有你哋一齐撑住，再大嘅逆境我哋都唔怕！善心汇聚，感恩有你，我们继续齐心守护社区！🔥🚨🎒❤

2025-11-27.enTitle: Still going: back at Wah Yuen Noodles in Yuen Long with care packages, rain or shine 🍱✨
2025-11-27.enVenue: Wah Yuen Noodles care package distribution, Yuen Long
2025-11-27.enBody:
Straight back out. On 27 November 2025, after the emergency work of the previous day, our volunteers returned to familiar ground — Wah Yuen Noodles in Yuen Long — for another round of care package distribution.

The team arrived in uniform and got straight into it: shifting supplies, counting packages, setting up the queue. Well-filled packages of food and everyday essentials were laid out in rows, ready for the 150 residents due that day.

Word that LucaBridge was back at Wah Yuen brought the regulars out early, and a queue formed well before we began. Our volunteers were on good form, handing over packages one by one with a warm word each time: "It's turning cold — take this and look after yourself."

Watching the surprise and relief on people's faces as they took their packages, and hearing "thank you LucaBridge, thank you for coming back", took the chill out of a late November afternoon. Aching arms and all, the team left feeling it had been worth the day.

A loud thank you to Wah Yuen Noodles for standing by us as they always do and for hosting us so well — with backing like that, we can keep bringing something good into this community — and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who turned out again despite a hard week.

With you alongside us, there is sunlight in every corner of this place. On to the next one. 🔥🎒🎁✨

2025-11-27.scTitle: 热血不息，大爱续航！重临元朗华苑粉面爆量派福袋，风雨无阻守护街坊暖心周末 🍱✨

2025-11-27.scBody:

一袋袋装满健康食品同日常必需品嘅沉甸甸福袋整齐排列，准备为前来嘅150位老友记同街坊送上最实质嘅支持与问候。得知乐桥再次嚟到华苑，一班老街坊同老友记一早就满怀期待咁排起长龙。我哋嘅热血义工个个打足十二分精神，化身最强「福气大使」，亲手将福袋逐一交到街坊手上，并用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音送上叮嘱：「长者们，最近天气转凉，攞袋福袋补补身，记住保重身体呀！」

看著老友记们接过福袋时，脸上展露出嘅惊喜与舒心笑容，听著那一声声真挚嘅「多谢乐桥、多谢你哋又过嚟」，现场满溢嘅人情味，直接将十一月尾嘅微凉秋意彻底融化！那一刻，大家就算搬到流晒大汗、手脚酸软，内心都觉得热血沸腾，成就感直接拉到最满！在这里要大声感谢华苑粉面一直以来嘅义气相挺与场地完美配合，因为有你哋嘅强力后盾，乐桥先可以源源不绝咁将正能量直送社区；更要向当日无惧疲劳、持之以恒过嚟出汗出力嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！

有你哋同行，社区每个角落都充满阳光！爱心不停步，乐桥永随行！走向下一个需要温暖嘅角落，下次再见！🔥🎒🎁✨

2025-11-30.enTitle: Yuen Long turns out again: a second round of care packages at Phone Factory, and a proprietor everyone agrees is as kind as he is good-looking 📱😎✨
2025-11-30.enVenue: Phone Factory care package distribution, Yuen Long
2025-11-30.enBody:
A good end to November, and Yuen Long got another round of it. On 30 November 2025 our volunteers were back at Phone Factory for a distribution of 150 care packages.

Supplies aside, the person everyone had their eye on was the proprietor — a man who gives his money and his time without being asked, and who is, by universal agreement, as good-looking as he is kind.

With backing like that and a perfect venue laid on, our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight into it, laying out well-filled packages of food and everyday essentials at speed. Word that LucaBridge and Phone Factory were teaming up again brought a queue to the door early, and the mood took the chill straight out of a late-November afternoon.

"Autumn's here — keep warm, and take a package to build yourself up." The greetings carried across the whole place. As package after package went into people's hands, and the elderly residents took ours and praised us without pause, the warmth in that room went right through the roof. Aching arms, thoroughly sweaty, and every volunteer flying.

From all of us and from the residents of Yuen Long, our loudest thanks to the proprietor of Phone Factory. Thank you for standing by us every time, and for proving what it looks like when someone's character matches their face (and what a face). Your support is the backing that keeps us moving. Full credit too to every LucaBridge volunteer who gave their all on the day.

November is done, but we are not. On to December. 🔥🎒🎁📱

2025-11-30-2.enTitle: The scars remain, but no one has gone cold — a supply point at Kwong Fuk Estate after the fire
2025-11-30-2.enBody:
On 30 November 2025, after the fire at Kwong Fuk Estate, our team set up a temporary supply point on the estate platform for the residents caught up in it.

That day the air on the platform still held everything that had not yet lifted — the weight of it, the grief. And at the same time, it held a remarkable amount of kindness.

Disaster has no feeling; people do. We were far from the only ones there. All around us were members of the public who had come of their own accord, from every direction, carrying the same grief and the same urgency. Each took up a position on the platform and quietly got on with it: someone passing over daily necessities, someone handing out dry food, someone bringing warm clothing.

On a platform that should have felt bleak, everyone held their own small corner and, through the quietest and steadiest kind of action, assembled a supply network nobody had organised. Not one of us knew the others. Behind the masks and the exhaustion, every face carried the same heaviness. But in that moment each of those positions became the warmest shelter available after the fire — because all any of us wanted was to tell the people who had lost everything one thing: you are not on your own.

The scars remain, but no one has gone cold.

Our thanks to every member of the public who stood on that platform and put a hand out, and to every resident who found the strength to hold others up in the middle of it. Rebuilding, and recovering from what this has done to people, will take a long time. But as long as we keep looking out for one another, that small light in the rubble will see people through to the other side.

Disaster has no feeling; people do.
2025-11-30-2.scTitle: 【火痕虽在，人心未冷】广福邨灾后物资派发点
2025-11-30-2.scBody:
在2025年11月30日——广福邨不幸发生火灾后。面对突如其来的灾情与受影响的街坊，我们团队在广福邨平台设立了临时物资派发点。那天的平台，空气中还凝结着未散尽的沉重与哀伤，但同时，亦凝聚了无数让人动容的善良。灾难无情，人间有爱。当日现场除了我们，更看见了许多令人肃然起敬的热心市民。大家怀着同样悲痛而焦急的心情，自发从四方八面赶来，在平台上各占一个位置，默默地分工合作：有人递上急需的日用品、有人分发干粮、有人送上御寒物资。

在那个原本充满阴霾的平台上，大家守着各自的小角落，用最无声却最坚定的行动，拼凑出一个自发的物资补给网。虽然大家互不相识，甚至在口罩与疲态背后，每个人脸上都带着沉重的哀伤。但那刻，每个人驻守的位置，都成为了灾后最温暖的避风港——我们只想用仅有的力量，向遭逢巨变的街坊说一声：你们并不孤单。「火痕虽在，人心未冷。」

感谢当天每一位在平台并肩站立、伸出援手的热心市民，以及在逆境中依然坚强互相扶持的每一位街坊。灾后的重建与心理创伤的平复路仍漫长，但只要我们继续守望相助，这份在废墟中亮起的微光，终能陪伴大家走出黑暗。

2025-12-02.enTitle: For the ones who run towards it: energy drinks and snacks handed to on-duty firefighters ⚡🔋🚒✨
2025-12-02.enBody:
They look after the city; we wanted to look after them. On 2 December 2025 our volunteers ran an outreach built entirely around saying thank you.

The fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po left us in no doubt about what firefighters do on the front line. To say so properly, we put together a substantial supply of energy drinks and energy bars and took them to the fire station.

It was a privilege to hand those over to the officers on duty. Watching them take the supplies with genuine warmth after a hard shift, and thank LucaBridge for coming, was something. "You look after the elderly, the neighbourhoods, all of Hong Kong. Thank you — stay safe out there."

What we brought was not really drinks and snacks; it was a whole community's backing, handed over in person. Being able to top up the tank for these people, even a little, left every volunteer proud of the day.

Our sincere thanks to the officers on duty for receiving us, and our warmest respect to every firefighter who protects the lives and homes of this city around the clock. It is because you run towards it that the rest of us get to live quietly.

Full credit too to the LucaBridge volunteers who came along to say it with us. Whether it is a community distribution or standing behind our emergency services, if there is a need, we will be there. 🔥

2025-12-02.scTitle: 致敬烈火雄心！乐桥特击送上爆量能量饮品与能量棒，亲手交托当值消防员，为城市守护者狠狠加油 ⚡🔋🚒✨
2025-12-02.scVenue: 消防局能量物资全体大应援
2025-12-02.scBody:
英雄守护城市，我哋守护英雄！喺2025年12月2日，乐桥义工大队展开了一场极具敬意与能量嘅送暖行动！早前大埔宏福苑火灾一役，我哋深刻感受到消防员长官们喺生死前线「抛头颅、洒热汗」、无惧水火嘅伟大精神。为咗表达我哋最崇高嘅谢意，当日我哋特别备齐了大批高能量物资——包括源源不绝嘅能量饮品同埋饱腹能量棒，全速直送消防局！

好荣幸能够亲手将呢批田能量物资，交畀当值嘅消防员长官！当看到消防员哥哥们虽然执勤辛劳，但依然用最挺拔、最亲切嘅笑容接过物资，并对乐桥连声道谢时，那一刻，现场嘅正能量与敬意直接冲破天际！「长者、街坊、以至全港市民都有你哋守护，辛苦晒各位消防员，行前线记住注意安全，加油！」义工们用最响亮、最真挚嘅声音送上问候。

2025-12-07.enTitle: Clearing the Gold Coast: volunteers brave the sea wind for a shoreline worth looking at 🧹🎒✨
2025-12-07.enVenue: Gold Coast beach clean-up, Tuen Mun
2025-12-07.enBody:
Looking after a community means looking after the natural world too. On 7 December 2025 our volunteers headed out of the city to the Gold Coast in Tuen Mun for a beach clean-up that tested everyone.

The sea wind had a bite to it, but the moment our volunteers reached the sand they were away. Gloves, bags and pickers out, the team spread across the beach and worked it methodically. Cigarette ends and fragments of plastic buried in the sand, discarded bottles and aluminium cans washed in by the tide — none of it got past them. Nobody minded the dirt or the effort; they bent down, worked hard, and cleared even the litter wedged deep between the rocks.

"Keep going! Every piece you pick up is one less hazard for marine life." The encouragement, and the laughter, carried all morning.

After most of a day, looking at 14 heavy bags piled up and then back at a beach that had got its golden shine back, the aching arms stopped mattering entirely.

Our deepest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who worked through the sea wind without complaint. Thank you for taking a solid step for the environment with your own hands.

Community work and environmental work — neither one stops. 🔥🌊🧹🎒

多谢你哋用双手同汗水，为环保行出最坚实嘅一步，用行动证明咩叫「美貌与善心并重」嘅守护者！大爱无界，绿色同行！乐桥送暖不停步，环保脚步亦绝不落空！🔥🌊🧹🎒

2025-12-09.enTitle: Through the worst of it: supplies delivered to Tai Po fire victims now housed at Kai Fuk Court transit housing 🏡💪✨
2025-12-09.enBody:
Fire and water have no feeling, but people do. Since the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on 26 November, our volunteers had stayed close to the residents affected by it. On 9 December 2025, hearing that some of them were now living at Kai Fuk Court transit housing and running short of supplies, we went straight there.

As far as LucaBridge is concerned, if a resident needs something, we find a way to get it to them.

Our volunteers arrived at Kai Fuk Court in uniform with washing machines, towels and cooking equipment, intending to give the people going through this transition the best we had. On arrival the team got straight to work — carrying, counting, distributing, all of it flowing. As we handed the supplies to residents and elderly people in person, we told them what we had come to say: "The home will be rebuilt, and until it is, LucaBridge and a great many kind people across Hong Kong are behind you. Look after yourselves."

The reassurance and trust in their faces at that moment was all the return this team needed. Watching people go from the fear of the fire itself to the ease on their faces as they took what we had brought, the warmth in that place cleared the December cold out entirely. However much lifting anyone had done, everybody left mended. That is what standing together looks like here, and it is what keeps us going.

Our sincere thanks to everyone at Kai Fuk Court transit housing for their full assistance and cooperation, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who worked through the day without a word.

Rebuilding will take a while, and we will be alongside people for it. 🔥🎒🎁🏡

2025-12-09.scTitle: 风雨同行，大爱不落空！全速进击启福居中转屋，爆量物资暖心直送大埔受灾街坊，携手共渡难关 🏡💪✨

水火无情，人情味更浓！自从11月26日大埔宏福苑发生突发火灾以来，乐桥义工大队嘅心一直与受灾街坊紧紧连在一起。喺2025年12月9日，得知部分受灾街坊目前正暂住于启福居中转屋、急需物资补充，我哋上下一心、义不容辞，即刻开展了这场充满温暖与速度嘅物资定点送暖行动！对于乐桥嚟讲，街坊有需要，我哋无论如何都要送到！

当日，我哋著住整齐醒目制服嘅热血义工队伍备齐了洗衣机，毛巾，炉具，抵达启福居中转屋，实行用最顶级嘅诚意，为正处于过渡期嘅大埔灾民注入满满嘅关怀与正能量！一到现场，义工们即刻火力全开，搬运、清点、分发，成个流程行云流水。当我哋亲手将呢批爱心物资递到受灾老友记同街坊手中，并用最响亮、最真挚嘅声音送上问候：「大家放心，家园虽然要重建，但有我哋乐桥同全港善心单位一齐撑住你哋！加油，保重身体！」

那一刻，街坊们眼神里流露出的安心、感动与信任，就是对我们整个团队最大嘅回报！看到街坊们从火灾时嘅徬徨，到今日接过物资时露出的舒心笑容，现场满溢嘅人情味，直接将十二月嘅寒意彻底驱散！大家就算搬到流晒大汗、手脚酸软，内心都被彻底治愈，成就感直接冲破天际！这就是同舟共济嘅香港精神，这就是乐桥永不熄灭嘅热血温度！

在这里要衷心感谢启福居中转屋相关单位嘅全力协助与场地配合，更要向当日无惧辛劳、默默付出嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！多谢你哋用汗水，为灾民筑起最温暖嘅港湾。逆境同行，大爱无疆！乐桥不停步，重建路上我哋继续并肩冲刺，将正能量传遍每一个角落！🔥🎒🎁🏡

2025-12-09-2.enTitle: An urgent call answered: emergency supplies delivered to Po Luk Hin, Tsing Lung Tau 💪🎒✨
2025-12-09-2.enVenue: Po Luk Hin, Tsing Lung Tau
2025-12-09-2.enBody:
Every bit of trust placed in us gets everything we have. On 9 December 2025, while we were fully committed to supporting the Tai Po fire victims, a call for help came in from Po Luk Hin in Tsing Lung Tau — a resident facing an immediate crisis and needing supplies urgently.

For LucaBridge it makes no difference whether it is a large community event or a single household asking for help. If someone comes to us, we clear whatever is in the way and get there as fast as we can.

On arrival, faced with a resident who was clearly shaken, we handed over the supplies and said what needed saying, gently and firmly: "LucaBridge is here. The supplies are with you now. Whatever this is, you're not facing it alone."

That kind of reassurance lands like a rush of warm air in the middle of winter. Watching the relief in their face on seeing us and taking the supplies is exactly why individual casework matters — it makes sure that even the smallest call for help gets a warm and immediate answer.

However big the obstacle, if someone needs us, we will keep turning up. 🔥🚨🎒❤
