2025-12-10.enTitle: Good food, good hearts: care packages handed out at Sing Fai Restaurant 🍲😎✨
2025-12-10.enVenue: Sing Fai Restaurant care package distribution
2025-12-10.enBody:
On 10 December 2025 our volunteers took the supply run straight to Sing Fai Restaurant for another round of care package distribution — a December greeting meant to warm both the stomach and everything else.

The team arrived in uniform and got straight into it. In no time the restaurant, inside and out, was stacked with 100 well-filled packages of everyday food and household essentials.

The volunteers divided the work between them, setting up the queue, keeping order and counting supplies with the kind of coordination that comes from doing this often. Word that LucaBridge was running a distribution at Sing Fai brought the regulars out early, and the place filled up. Volunteers handed the packages over in person, steadying anyone unsteady on their feet, and chatted away in warm Cantonese while they did it.

"It's turned cold — take a package, build yourself up, and keep well." That, over and over, all afternoon. Watching the elderly residents take their packages with those easy, sunlit smiles, and hearing "thank you for coming all this way", left every volunteer restored, however sweaty and sore.

A loud thank you to Sing Fai Restaurant for their full support and for hosting us so well — with help like that, what we bring reaches the right people in the right way — and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who worked hard through the day. 🔥🎒🎁✨

「长者们，最近天气冻喇，攞袋福袋补补身，祝你哋身体健康、开开心心呀！」一声声真挚嘅叮嘱在菜馆内此起彼落。看到老友记们接过福袋时，脸上展露出如阳光般灿烂、舒心嘅笑容，听著那一声声温暖嘅「多谢你哋特登过嚟呀」，全场义工就算搬到汗流浃背、手脚酸软，内心都被彻底治愈，成就感直接冲破天际！在这里要大声感谢星辉菜馆嘅全力支持与场地完美配合，因为有你哋嘅大力协助，爱心才可以更精准、更舒适咁送到有需要嘅人手中！

2025-12-13.enTitle: Cards down, December lit up: LucaBridge and Din Din House run a second charity Pokémon TCG tournament 🔥🎒✨
2025-12-13.enVenue: Din Din House x LucaBridge charity Pokémon TCG tournament
2025-12-13.enBody:
Back for a second run. On 13 December 2025 LucaBridge and Din Din House reopened their partnership with a charity Pokémon TCG tournament that a lot of people had been waiting for.

After how well the first one went, we teamed up again to turn something that belongs to young people and to players into a force for the community.

On the day, Din Din House filled up early with strong players from across Hong Kong and a large crowd of Pokémon fans, and the atmosphere went up accordingly. Our volunteers and the Din Din House team had everything ready well in advance — the room laid out, the draw done, supplies prepared, the queue managed — with the kind of coordination that only comes from having done it before.

Once play began the room was electric. All 34 competitors were locked in, matching wits across the tables, and every draw and every play drew a reaction from the crowd.

The best part was that nobody there was only enjoying a tournament. Every competitor and every spectator was turning their enthusiasm for the game into donations and supplies — a generation of players proving they have as much heart as skill. Watching the competitors sweating and grinning through it, and the energy in that room, our volunteers and the Din Din House team knew exactly what it had been for.

This was not just a well-run tournament; it was about as creative a piece of charity work as we do. Our loudest thanks to Din Din House. Thank you for backing us every time, and for giving us the venue and the enthusiasm that make this kind of thing possible. Full credit too to the LucaBridge volunteers who worked through the day, and to every player who came to compete with something bigger in mind.

We'll see you at the next one. 🔥🃏🎒⚡

2025-12-13.scVenue: 电电屋 × 乐桥：PTCG慈善大赛再次合办
2025-12-13.scBody:

而最让人感动嘅是，现场每一位参赛者、每一位观战嘅街坊，不单止是在享受比赛，更加是透过呢个平台，将自己对卡牌嘅热爱转化为善款同爱心物资，用行动证明咩叫「美貌、智慧与善心并重」嘅新世代玩家！看着全场流晒大汗却笑得无比灿烂嘅参赛者，以及现场满溢嘅青春活力同人情味，全场上下挥汗如雨嘅乐桥义工伙伴同电电屋团队都觉得所有辛苦都完全值得！

这不单止是一场高水平嘅电竞赛事，更加是一场最完美、最具创意嘅潮流跨界慈善传承！在这里要大声向电电屋致以最崇高、最热烈嘅谢意！多谢你哋每一次都咁义气相挺、倾力合作，用最专业嘅场地同热情，成为乐桥源源不绝推动「潮流慈善」嘅最强战友！同时亦要大赞当日所有到场力撑、出汗出力嘅乐桥热血义工家人，以及所有心怀大爱、热血参赛嘅卡牌英雄！

热爱不灭，大爱永随！乐桥 × 电电屋慈善连线大获全胜，让我们继续在不同嘅领域开疆辟土、播撒善良嘅种子，我们期待下一场PTCG再见！🔥🃏🎒⚡

2025-12-20.enTitle: Birthdays and Christmas at once: laughter, singing and a party with the residents of On Sum Kui 🎄🎤✨
2025-12-20.enBody:
Two celebrations in one. On 20 December 2025 our volunteers headed to On Sum Kui for a combined Christmas party and birthday celebration for the residents — double the good wishes, in a season made for it.

The team got straight to work on arrival: balloons up, decorations hung, birthday cake laid out along with 110 small Christmas gifts. In no time the whole place felt like the season.

Once the residents were seated and settled, the party got going properly. The centrepiece was our volunteers' own contribution — they sang. When the music started, volunteers took the microphone and gave the room one classic after another, along with a few carols. The residents were captivated, clapping along, waving, and eventually singing with them, until the whole home had turned into the warmest concert you could imagine.

After the singing came the cake, with everyone joining in for both "Happy Birthday" and the carols, and volunteers of all ages handing out slices and care packages to each resident in person. Watching the birthday residents take their gifts with those bright, contented smiles, and hearing them hold our hands and say "thank you LucaBridge, this has been a lovely day", left every volunteer there thoroughly restored.

This was not only a party; it was proper company, using music to put a bit of warmth down roots in this home. Our sincere thanks to all the staff at On Sum Kui for their excellent cooperation, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who gave everything on the day — including their singing voices. Thank you for lighting up these residents' winter.

December's work is well under way. 🔥🎒🎂🎄🎤✨

2025-12-20.scTitle: 双重喜庆，乐韵传爱！进击安心居与公公婆婆爆笑庆生兼过圣诞，热血义工深情献唱，温暖歌声融化冬日 🎄🎤✨
2025-12-20.scBody:
大爱交织，幸福双击！喺2025年12月20日，乐桥义工大队上下一心、干劲依然爆灯，我哋走入了充满温馨情怀嘅**「安心居」，开展了一场别开生面、热闹非凡嘅圣诞联欢暨长者生日会 **！我们要喺这个充满感恩嘅季节，一次过为公公婆婆送上双倍嘅祝福、双倍嘅快乐！一到现场，二话不说即刻火力全开！吹气球、挂装饰、排好精美嘅生日蛋糕同110份圣诞小礼物，成个安心居一瞬间被浓浓嘅节日气氛彻底包围。

当公公婆婆们高高兴兴、秩序井然咁进场坐好，一场兼具人情味与视听享受嘅「爱心大派对」正式引爆！今次活动嘅超级重头戏，绝对系我哋热血义工家人嘅定点特别奉献——现场献唱！当音乐响起，我哋嘅义工拿著麦克风化身巨星，用最深情、最宏亮、最动听嘅歌声，为台下嘅公公婆婆送上一首首经典金曲同圣诞报佳音。台下嘅老友记们听得如痴如醉，个个自觉地跟住节奏拍手、挥手，甚至一齐大合唱，整个现场化成了最温暖嘅演唱会现场，幸福感直接拉到最满！

唱完金曲，义工们随即推出大蛋糕，全场齐声高唱生日歌同圣诞歌，并由大义工、小义工们分工合作，亲手将一块块甜到入心嘅蛋糕同暖心福袋逐一交到公公婆婆手中。看到寿星公、寿星婆们接过祝福时，脸上展露出如冬日阳光般灿烂、满足嘅笑容，听著那一声声拉著我哋手连连称赞嘅「多谢乐桥、今日好开心呀」，那一刻，全场上下挥汗如雨嘅义工伙伴内心都被彻底治愈，觉得所有辛苦都完全值得！

这不单止是一场节日庆祝，更是一场最美丽嘅心灵陪伴，用音乐同陪伴让爱与温暖在安心居深深扎根。在这里要衷心感谢安心居全体工作人员嘅完美配合，更加要向当日全情投入、出汗出力、甚至「抛头颅、献歌喉」用极致温柔守护街坊嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！多谢你哋用歌声同笑声，点亮了公公婆婆嘅冬日回忆！善心汇聚，乐韵飘扬！

十二月嘅送暖步伐圆满推进，让我们将这份正能量，温暖继续传递到更多角落！🔥🎒🎂🎄🎤✨

2025-12-22.enTitle: When work disappears: an emergency care package for a family facing food and rent at the same time 💪🎒🎁✨
2025-12-22.enBody:
Every call for help gets heard, and acted on. On 22 December 2025, the winter solstice, while households across the city were preparing to mark it, we received an urgent request that was hard to read.

A resident had lost their job suddenly and was in real difficulty — struggling for everyday food and for the rent. Learning that they were facing running out of food entirely, we mobilised immediately, put supplies together and went.

As far as LucaBridge is concerned, it makes no difference whether it is a major community event or one household with nowhere to turn. If you come to us, we clear whatever is in the way and become whatever shelter we can.

We put together a care package of food and the essentials most urgently needed and took it to them. The bag itself does not weigh much; what it carries is this whole team's concern and support.

On arrival we handed the supplies over and said what needed saying, gently and firmly: "Don't be frightened, and don't panic. This is temporary. LucaBridge and a lot of kind people across Hong Kong are behind you. Let's get through the solstice together — please don't give up."

That kind of reassurance arrives like a rush of warm air in the middle of winter. Watching the helplessness in their eyes give way to relief, and then to something like hope, is exactly what casework is for: making sure that nobody who hits the bottom is left there on their own.

Our outreach does not stop. 🔥🚨🎒❤

2025-12-22.scTitle: 风雨同舟，有求必应！街坊失业痛击生计、食物交租顿成难关，乐桥极速驰援送福袋，尽显人间有情 💪🎒🎁✨
2025-12-22.scBody:
每一声呼求，我哋都听喺心里、行动喺最前线！喺2025年12月22日呢个冬至佳节，正当家家户户准备做冬之际，乐桥义工大队接获了一个令人痛心嘅紧急求助个案。有街坊因为突然失业，生活陷入困境，甚至连日常食物同应付租金都成问题。得知求助者正面临迫在眉睫嘅断粮同生活危机，我哋义不容辞，即刻启动「热血救援机制」，调配物资，尽我哋全体乐桥最大嘅心意，开展这场雷霆送暖行动！

对于乐桥嚟讲，不论是大型社区盛事，还是单一街坊嘅无助呼求，只要你揾我哋，我哋就一定排除万难，做你最坚实嘅避风港！一收到消息，我哋备齐了装满食品、急需生活物资嘅福袋送求助街坊手中！这袋福袋虽然重量有限，但入面承载着嘅，是我们整个团队百分百嘅关怀、支持与祝福！一到现场，将物资交到街坊手中，并用最响亮、最温柔、最坚定嘅声音送上最真挚嘅安慰同鼓励：「唔使惊、唔使急！难关只系暂时嘅，有我哋乐桥同全港善心人一齐撑住你，今个冬至我哋一齐过，加油，千祈唔好放弃！」

呢一声声直击心坎嘅问候，犹如寒冬中嘅一股超强暖流，瞬间融化了求助者眼中的无助与徬徨。看到街坊接过福袋、感受到乐桥嘅温度时，眼神里流露出的那份安心、释怀与重燃希望嘅光芒！这就是个案支援嘅最大价值——确保社会上任何一个陷入低谷嘅灵魂，都不会被孤单遗下，都能得到最即时、最温暖嘅拥抱！逆境同行，大爱无疆！送暖步伐从不停歇，让我们嘅正能量，守护每一个需要我哋嘅街坊！🔥🚨🎒❤

2025-12-26.enTitle: Boxing Day encore: LucaBridge returns to Yan Wo Home for the Elderly with singing, dancing and a proper Christmas party 🎤💃✨
2025-12-26.enVenue: Yan Wo Home for the Elderly
2025-12-26.enBody:
Christmas was not going to end there. On Boxing Day 2025 our volunteers headed back to Yan Wo Home for the Elderly for a Christmas party we intended the residents to remember.

On arrival the team carried in 35 Christmas gifts, put up balloons and set the sound system, and the home filled with Christmas in short order.

Once the residents were seated in their Christmas hats and in good spirits, the party started properly. Returning to Yan Wo, our volunteers went all out with the main event — singing and dancing, live. When the music came on, volunteers took the microphone and carried the room, while another group took to the front and danced.

Watching the volunteers give it everything, the residents were captivated and delighted. Plenty of them caught the mood and clapped and waved along with the rhythm, until the home had turned into the warmest concert venue in the city.

After the party, volunteers young and old formed a chain and handed each resident a Christmas gift and a care package in person. Watching the residents take them with those bright, contented smiles, holding our hands and telling us "LucaBridge really knows how to put on a day", left every volunteer thoroughly restored.

This was not only a party; it was about as easy and unforced a piece of contact between generations as you could ask for, with singing and dancing doing the work.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Yan Wo Home for the Elderly for their excellent cooperation and support, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who gave everything on the day, singing and dancing included. Thank you for lighting up these residents' Christmas.

We can't wait to do it again. 🔥🎒🎄🎤💃✨

2025-12-26.scBody:

看到义工们卖力演出，台下嘅公公婆婆个个听得如痴如征、看得眉开眼笑！不少老友记更被我哋嘅热血活力感染，自觉地跟着节奏拍手、挥手，成个安老院一瞬间化成了最震撼、最温暖嘅演唱会现场，幸福感同欢笑声直接冲破天际！狂欢过后，大义工、小义工们默契配合，形成最强「爱心传送带」，将一份份精美嘅圣诞礼物同福袋逐一亲手交到长者手中。

看到公公婆婆们接过祝福时，脸上展露出如阳光般灿烂、满足嘅笑容，拉住我哋嘅手大赞「乐桥真系好热闹、好好玩」，那一刻，全场上下挥汗如雨嘅义工伙伴内心都被彻底治愈，觉得所有辛苦都完全值得！这不单止是一场节日派对，更是一场最美丽、最无隔阂嘅跨代互动，用最纯粹嘅歌声与舞步，让爱与善良嘅种子深深札根在长者心田。

在这里要衷心感谢恩和安老院全体工作人员嘅完美配合与大力支持，更加要向当日全情投入、出汗出力、甚至「抛头颅、大秀舞技歌喉」嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！多谢你哋用汗水同笑声，点亮了老友记嘅圣诞回忆！善心汇聚，舞动全城！我们期待再次与各公公婆婆再一次劲歌热舞！🔥🎒🎄🎤💃✨

2025-12-27.enTitle: The Christmas run continues: volunteers bring the stage to Shun On Home for the Elderly in Sham Shui Po 🎤💃✨
2025-12-27.enVenue: Shun On Home for the Elderly, Sham Shui Po
2025-12-27.enBody:
Still going. On 27 December 2025, after several consecutive days of outreach, our volunteers headed to familiar ground in Sham Shui Po — Shun On Home for the Elderly — for another Christmas party.

The team set up the room, prepared 44 Christmas care packages and tested the sound, and Shun On filled with red and green and a good deal of anticipation.

Once the residents were seated in their Christmas hats, the song-and-dance showcase began. The moment the music started, our most musical volunteers took the microphone and worked through one well-loved classic after another, while another group took to the front and danced.

Watching the volunteers give it everything, the residents were captivated and beaming. Plenty of them caught the mood and clapped and cheered along, until the home had turned into a concert hall.

After the singing and dancing, volunteers young and old worked together to hand each resident a bag of carefully chosen Christmas gifts. Watching the residents take them with those bright, easy smiles, and hearing them hold our hands and say "thank you LucaBridge, what a day", left every volunteer restored.

This was not only a party; it was proper company, with music and dancing removing whatever distance there might have been, and letting a bit of kindness settle into this community.

Our sincere thanks to all the staff at Shun On Home for the Elderly for their support and excellent cooperation, and our deepest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who, despite a hard run of days, gave everything they had — singing and dancing included. Thank you for lighting up Christmas in Sham Shui Po.

December's outreach is well and truly done. See you next time. 🔥🎒🎄🎤💃✨

On 27 December 2025, after several consecutive days of outreach, our volunteers headed to familiar ground in Sham Shui Po — Shun On Home for the Elderly — for another Christmas party. 2025-12-27.scTitle: 圣诞狂欢，接力进击！乐桥空降深水埗顺安老人院，义工热血献唱大秀舞姿，与老友记High翻冬日舞台 🎤💃✨
2025-12-27.scBody:
大爱不停步，快乐传万家！喺2025年12月27日，经历过连日嘅送暖行动后，乐桥义工大队上下一心、干劲依然爆灯！我哋进击深水埗老地方——「顺安老人院」，展开新一场充满欢声笑语嘅圣诞庆祝大派对，要把最纯粹、最极致嘅节日温暖直送老友记心坎！一到现场，热血义工们布置场地、准备44份圣诞福袋、测试音响，成个顺安老人院瞬间被红红绿绿嘅圣诞装饰包围，洋溢著蓄势待发嘅澎湃正能量。

当一班最可爱嘅公公婆婆戴上圣诞帽、齐整咁坐好之后，我哋嘅星级「劲歌热舞」大汇演正式震撼开锣！台前音乐一响，才华担当嘅义工即刻拿起麦克风化身最强歌王，深情献唱一首首耳熟能详嘅经典金曲；与此同时，另一班热血义工更加化身「舞林高手」，在台前尽情排舞、热力四射！看到义工们出汗出力、卖力演出，台下嘅老友记个个听得如痴如醉、笑逐颜开，不少长者更加被我哋嘅热血活力感染，自觉地跟住节奏一齐拍手、欢呼，成个老人院一瞬间化成了最温馨、最震撼嘅万人演唱会现场，幸福感直接拉到最满！

欢乐嘅歌舞过后，大义工、小义工们默契配合，亲手将一袋袋精心准备、圣诞小礼物逐一送到长者手上。看著老友记们接过祝福时，脸上展露出如阳光般灿烂、满足嘅舒心笑容，听著那一声声拉著我哋手连连称赞嘅「多谢乐桥、今日真系好热闹呀」，那一刻，全场上下挥汗如雨嘅义工伙伴内心都被彻底治愈，成就感直接冲破天际！这不单止是一场节日派对，更是一场最美丽嘅心灵陪伴，用音乐同舞步打破隔阂，让爱与善良在社区深深扎根。

在这里要衷心感谢顺安老人院全体工作人员嘅大力支持与完美配合，更加要向当日无惧疲劳、全情投入、甚至「抛头颅、大秀舞技歌喉」嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高嘅敬意！多谢你哋用汗水同笑声，点亮了深水埗老友记嘅圣诞回忆！十二月嘅送暖步伐圆满推进，我们下次再见！🔥🎒🎄🎤💃✨

2026-01-01.enTitle: New Year's Day at Tin Yuet Estate: registration opens on day one of 2026 for the 7 January distribution 🎒🎁✨
2026-01-01.enVenue: Tin Yuet Estate, Tin Shui Wai
2026-01-01.enBody:
A new year, and no let-up. On New Year's Day 2026, while most people were still on holiday, our volunteers were already out for the first outreach of the year.

We headed to Tin Yuet Estate in Tin Shui Wai to run registration ahead of the care package distribution set for 7 January — the first gift of the new year for the residents there.

Public holiday or not, our volunteers arrived and immediately set up the registration desk, prepared the forms and organised the queue.

Word that LucaBridge had come out on the first day of the year brought the residents of Tin Yuet Estate out in force, and a queue formed early. Our volunteers were on excellent form, working through each elderly resident's registration carefully and patiently. They did more than paperwork, too — they wished everyone a happy new year while they were at it: "Happy new year! Stay well! Remember to come down on 7 January for your package."

Watching residents finish their registration in good spirits, with that reassured look on their faces, and hearing them hold our hands and say "you came out on New Year's Day for us — thank you", took the chill out of early January entirely. Sweaty and sore as everyone was, the team was flying. Opening 2026 by serving this community was about as good a start as we could have asked for.

Our sincere thanks to the coordinating team at Tin Yuet Estate for their support and excellent cooperation, and our warmest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who gave up their holiday to be there.

Registration done. Next stop, 7 January. 🔥🎒📋🎁✨

2026-01-01.scTitle: 元旦强势开局，大爱进击天悦邨！2026新年第一天即刻全速推进，为7号福袋大派发开展雷霆登记 🎒🎁✨
2026-01-01.scBody:
全新一年，热血不减，大爱再升级！喺2026年1月1日元旦日，正当大家沉浸喺新年假期之际，乐桥义工大队已经整装待发，开展了新一年的首场暖心行动！我哋进击天水围天悦邨，为即将喺1月7号举行嘅「开年福袋大派发」提前进行定点登记，实行用最极致嘅效率同诚意，为天悦邨嘅街坊老友记送上新年第一份大礼！活动当日，虽然正值元旦假期，但我哋一班热血义工一到场就即刻搭起登记站、准备好登记表格、拉起秩序防线。

得知乐桥喺新年第一天就特登过嚟为大家服务，天悦邨嘅街坊同老友记群情汹涌，一早就喺登记站前排起了长龙，现场气氛热闹到直接点燃了元旦嘅冬日！我哋嘅义工个个化身成最亲切嘅「开年福气大使」，打足十二分精神，细心、耐心地为每一位前来嘅长者办理登记手续。大家唔单止做登记，仲贴心咁向老人家拜个早年，用最响亮、最真挚嘅声音送上节日问候：「公公婆婆，新年快乐！身体健康！记住1月7号落嚟攞福袋呀！」

看著街坊们高高兴兴办好登记，脸上展露出如元旦阳光般灿烂、安心嘅舒心笑容，听著那一声声拉著我哋手连连称赞嘅「你哋元旦都咁辛苦过嚟，真系多谢晒乐桥呀」，现场满溢嘅浓厚人情味，直接将一月头嘅寒意彻底驱散！那一刻，全场上下虽然忙到流晒大汗、手脚酸软，但内心都觉得热血沸腾，成就感直接冲破天际！用服务社区来开启2026年，简直系最完美、最幸福嘅开局！

在这里要衷心感谢天悦邨相关协调单位嘅大力支持与完美配合，因为有你哋嘅强力后盾，乐桥先可以源源不绝咁将正能量直送街坊身边；更要向当日放弃放假、全情投入、出汗出力嘅每一位乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！有你哋同行，2026年嘅第一天充满了爱与温暖！新年新气象，大爱不停步！1月1号嘅登记大行动完成，紧接而来嘅就是1月7号嘅福袋大派发！我们下一站——7号天悦邨现场见！🔥🎒📋🎁✨

2026-01-07.enTitle: A promise delivered: the Tin Yuet Estate care package distribution lands in full, and residents tell us LucaBridge does what it says 🎒✨
2026-01-07.enVenue: Tin Yuet Estate, Tin Shui Wai
2026-01-07.enBody:
A promise is a promise. Following the registration drive at Tin Yuet Estate on New Year's Day, our volunteers returned in force on 7 January 2026 for the distribution itself.

The team arrived early in uniform and got straight into it — moving supplies, counting packages, checking names against the New Year's Day registration list, organising the queue — with the kind of coordination that comes from practice. Rows of well-filled packages of household essentials, food and seasonal items were laid out, ready to give the residents something solid to start the year with.

Word that LucaBridge had come back to deliver brought everyone who had registered out early, and the place filled up. Our volunteers handed each package over in person, and offered a belated new year greeting with it: "LucaBridge is back! Take a package, build yourself up, and here's to a healthy and happy year."

Watching the residents take their packages with those bright, reassured smiles, and hearing "we registered on New Year's Day and here you are — thank you", took the chill out of the middle of January. Sweaty and sore as everyone was, the team left flying.

Our sincere thanks to the coordinating team at Tin Yuet Estate for their strong support and for hosting us so well, and our warmest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who keeps turning this into practice rather than intention.

A good start to 2026. We'll do everything we can to reach more people this year. 🔥🎒🎁✨

2026-01-07.scTitle: 新年承诺，使命必达！天悦邨开年福袋大派发完美全垒打，热血义工总动员，爆量物资全数直送街坊心坎 🎒 老友记激赞：乐桥真系讲得出做得到！✨
2026-01-07.scBody:
一诺千金，大爱承传！继1月1日元旦日我哋全速进击天水围天悦邨进行定点登记之后，喺2026年1月7日，乐桥义工大队嘅热血物资战车再次浩浩荡荡驶入天悦邨，正式展开一场万众期待、规模盛大嘅「开年福袋大派发大行动」！活动当日，我哋著住整齐醒目制服嘅热血义工队伍一早已经到达现场，大家完全冇一丝怠慢，即刻火力全开！

搬运物资、清点福袋、对核元旦登记名单、拉起防线维持秩序，成个团队展示出教科书级别嘅极致默契。一袋袋装满日常起居必需品、健康食品、应节物资同满满开年祝福嘅沉甸甸福袋整齐排列，准备为街坊送上全新一年最实质、最贴心嘅支持。得知乐桥履行承诺过嚟大派福袋，天悦邨先前办好登记嘅老友记同街坊一早已经高高兴兴咁排起长龙，现场人头涌涌、热闹非凡。

我哋嘅热血义工个个化身成最强「开年福气大使」，打足十二分精神，双手将福袋逐一亲手交到长者手上。大家唔单止送物资，仲贴心咁向老街坊拜个迟来嘅新年，用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音叮嘱：「公公婆婆，我哋乐桥又嚟喇！攞袋福袋补补身，祝你哋全新一年身体健康、出入平安、开开心心呀！」看着老友记们接过福袋时，脸上展露出如冬日阳光般灿烂、满足同安心嘅舒心笑容，听着那一声声真挚嘅「上次元旦登记完，今日真系派喇，多谢晒乐桥你哋呀」，现场满溢嘅浓厚人情味，直接将一月中嘅寒意彻底驱散！

那一刻，全场上下虽然忙到流晒大汗、手脚酸软，但内心都觉得热血沸腾，成就感直接冲破天际！在这里要衷心感谢天悦邨相关协调单位嘅大力支持与场地完美配合，因为有你哋嘅强力后盾，乐桥先可以源源不绝咁将正能量直送长者身边；更要向当日全情投入、出汗出力、持之以恒实践大爱嘅每一位乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！

有你哋同行，2026年嘅开局充满了爱与温暖！开年大吉，善行不止！天悦邨福袋大派发嘅完成，新嘅一年，我哋会尽最大既努力, 守护更多街坊，我们下次见！🔥🎒🎁✨

2026-01-18.enTitle: 350 care packages for Tin Ching Estate — carried upstairs and delivered to residents with limited mobility 👵❤
2026-01-18.enBody:
On 18 January our volunteers went to Tin Ching Estate for another round of community outreach, distributing 350 care packages of practical household supplies.

As well as the distribution point itself, the team made arrangements for the residents whose health kept them at home. Volunteers split into several small groups and took 50 of the packages upstairs, delivering them to residents with limited mobility in person.

Going door to door, the teams handed over the supplies and stayed to talk, asking patiently about people's health and how they were managing day to day, so that the help reached exactly where it was needed and actually answered what people were struggling with.

Our thanks to every LucaBridge volunteer who worked the stairs all day without complaint. We will keep doing this kind of grounded community work and reaching more households that need it. 🌱✨

于1月18日，乐桥义工团队前往天晴邨展开新一轮社区关怀行动，合共派发了350份装满实用生活物资的爱心福袋。活动当日，除了在定点摊位为街坊进行派发外，团队亦特别关顾到部分因身体状况未能出门的老友记。为此，义工们即时分成了几个关怀小队，落手落脚将其中50份福袋亲自上门送到行动不便的长者家中。上楼送暖期间，义工小队逐家逐户登门探访，一边为长者送上物资，一边耐心地与他们聊天、关心他们的身体及起居状况，确保这份温暖能够精准送达，真正做到解街坊所急。

感谢当日不辞劳苦、上楼下楼出汗出力的每一位乐桥义工伙伴。未来我哋会继续实践这份踏实的社区关怀，守护更多有需要的家庭！🌱✨

2026-01-25.enTitle: LucaBridge x Phone Factory: care packages handed out ahead of the new year, and a lot of sweat 📱🎒🔥✨
2026-01-25.enBody:
On 25 January 2026 our volunteers took the supply run to Phone Factory — a place with as much neighbourhood character as it has technology — for a care package distribution ahead of the new year.

On arrival, Phone Factory inside and out filled up with well-stocked packages of good food, practical supplies and household essentials.

Our volunteers and the Phone Factory team worked together with real coordination, dividing the work, setting up the queue and keeping order, and the whole shop filled with anticipation.

Word of the distribution brought 150 residents out early in good spirits, and the place was busy from the start. Our volunteers handed each package over with both hands and a warm word, and the greetings carried across the shop all day.

Watching the elderly residents take their packages with those bright, easy smiles, and hearing them hold our hands and say thank you, left every volunteer restored, however sweaty and sore.

A loud thank you to Phone Factory for their full support, their generosity and for hosting us so well. Because you back us the way you do, technology and community work fit together, and what we bring reaches people properly.

And our warmest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who made time in a busy pre-new-year week to be there. See you next time. 🔥🎒🎁📱⚡

2026-01-31.enTitle: Students take on Lamma Island: LucaBridge joins Sing Yin Secondary School and Leung Shek Chee College to visit the wind turbine and clear the shoreline 💨🎒🌱✨
2026-01-31.enBody:
On 31 January 2026 our volunteers ran a green conservation day built as much around learning as around work.

We were very glad to be joined by students from two excellent schools — Sing Yin Secondary School and Leung Shek Chee College — for a trip to Lamma Island that put technology and community practice side by side.

Our first stop was the Lamma Winds power station, for a close look at the turbine itself. With their teachers explaining as we went, the students were absorbed, and came away with a proper understanding of why renewable energy matters to Hong Kong's future. A field trip like that does something a textbook cannot.

Then came the part that tested everyone: clearing the shoreline. The students and our volunteers formed up quickly, kitted out with gloves, bags and pickers, and headed down to the beach. Faced with plastic waste and marine litter washed up across the sand and lodged between the rocks, nobody minded the sun or the wind. They bent down, worked every corner, and between them filled and carried away 45 bags.

Everyone was sweaty and sore by the end, but the beach had gone back to being clean and pleasant, and the pride among the students and volunteers was obvious.

This was more than volunteering; it was a proper handover between generations, with young people paying their respects to the natural world through their own effort.

A loud thank you to all the staff and students of Sing Yin Secondary School and Leung Shek Chee College for their full support and commitment — the energy and discipline you showed set a real standard. And our warmest respect to the LucaBridge volunteers who led the day.

Thank you for what you did for the Lamma Island shoreline. We'll keep at it. 🔥🎒🌊🌱💨✨

2026-01-31.scVenue: 南丫岛绿色环保大联线
2026-01-31.scBody:
大爱同行，守护蓝天碧海！喺2026年1月31日，乐桥义工大队上下一心、干劲依然爆灯，我哋开展了一场极具教育意义与环保价值的「绿色生态保育大作战」！今次我哋非常荣幸，能够联同圣言中学与梁式芝书院两所杰出学校嘅精英学生，一同乘风破浪进击南丫岛，实行将科技探索与社区实践完美结合，过一个最充实、最热血嘅绿色冬日！

第一站我哋前往「南丫风采发电站」，近距离直击宏伟嘅巨大风车发电设施。喺老师介绍下，同学们个个听得津津有味、眼神发光，深入了解再生能源对香港未来发展嘅重要性。呢一场教科书级别嘅实地考察，直接打破了课本嘅框架，将环保意识深深烙印喺每一位年轻人嘅心田！探索完绿色科技，真正考验体力与默契嘅重头戏正式引爆——雷霆清洁海岸线大行动！

同学们同乐桥义工迅速组成最强环保战队，带齐手套、垃圾袋、铁夹，火力全开空降南丫岛海滩。面对石缝间、沙滩上被冲刷上岸嘅塑胶废料同海洋垃圾，大家完全无惧烈日与海风，弯下腰、俯下身，不放过任何一个角落，分工合作将45袋垃圾一袋袋装满、搬走。看著大家搬到流晒大汗、手脚酸软，但海滩喺我哋共同努力下，一瞬间回复了原本嘅洁净、美丽与舒适，那一刻，全场青年学生同义工伙伴内心都涌现出无比嘅自豪与治愈感！

这不单止是一次义务工作，更是一场最深刻嘅跨代环境承传，用年轻人嘅双手，向大自然致以最崇高嘅敬意！在这里要大声感谢圣言中学与梁式芝书院嘅全体师生全力支持与全情投入，你哋展示出嘅青春活力同高度纪律，简直系新世代青年嘅最强榜样！同时亦要向当日带队、出汗出力、持之以恒实践大爱嘅乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！

多谢你哋用汗水点亮了南丫岛嘅海岸线！山水相依，知行合一！让我们继续带著呢份澎湃嘅正能量，迎向全新嘅一年！我们会为环保继续冲刺，守护我哋嘅美丽家园！🔥🎒🌊🌱💨✨

2026-02-08.enTitle: Ink and good wishes: hand-written fai chun brushed on the spot and given away for Lunar New Year ✍🎒🔥✨
2026-02-08.enBody:
The warmest new year wishes are the hand-written kind. On 8 February 2026, in the middle of the Lunar New Year season, our volunteers set up in the community to give away hand-written fai chun, brushed on the spot.

The team arrived early, laid out the red paper and set up the brushes and ink, and the stall filled with red and with the season.

Once our calligraphy volunteers started, the brushwork flowed, and one fai chun after another appeared — good health, safe travels, energy for the year ahead. Printed ones look fine, but a hand-written one carries something a printer cannot. Our volunteers handed each one over in person, still faintly smelling of ink.

They did more than hand them out, too — they wished everyone a proper new year while they were at it: "Happy new year! Take one home and put it up — health, good fortune and happiness to the whole family this year."

Watching the residents take their fai chun and pick out the wish they wanted, with those bright, surprised, pleased faces, and hearing them hold our hands and say "you've really thought about this — thank you", was community work doing exactly what it should: carrying a tradition forward and warming people up in the process.

Our sincere thanks to the LucaBridge calligraphy volunteers who wrote until their hands ached and kept going. Thank you for what that ink did for this neighbourhood's new year. See you at the next one. 🔥🎒🧧✍✨

活动当日，一早已经到达现场，铺好红纸、备好笔墨、成个摊位一瞬间被红当当、喜气洋洋嘅节日气氛彻底包围。当我哋嘅书法义工一落笔，笔走龙蛇、劲道十足，一幅幅「龙马精神」、「出入平安」、「身体健康」嘅精美挥春陆续诞生印刷嘅挥春虽然精美，但手写嘅挥春才最具有直击心坎嘅温度！我哋嘅热血义工化身成最强「新春福气大使」将散发著淡淡墨香嘅手写挥春逐一亲手交到长者同街坊手上。

大家唔单止送挥春，仲贴心咁向老街坊拜个正月中嘅热闹年，用最响亮、最亲切嘅声音叮嘱：「公公婆婆、街坊们！新春快乐！攞幅手写挥春返屋企贴，保佑全家全新一年身体健康、横财就手、开开心心！」看著老友记们接过挥春、挑选到自己心水祝福时，脸上展露出如春日阳光般灿烂、满足同惊喜嘅舒心笑容，听著那一声声拉著我哋手连连称赞嘅「你哋真系有心，多谢晒乐桥呀」，现场满溢嘅浓厚人情味，这就是社区服务嘅最大价值——用最纯粹嘅行动，传承文化，温暖人心！

在这里要衷心感谢「写到手软」都坚持为街坊送上最好祝愿嘅乐桥热血义工书法家，多谢你哋用墨香，点亮了整个社区嘅新春回忆！善心汇聚，福气绵延！让我们继续将呢份正能量，让温暖传递到更多角落，下一站再见！🔥🎒🧧✍✨

2026-02-13.enTitle: The smallest visitors: LucaBridge and Ying Yeung Lok Yi Anglo-Chinese Kindergarten bring games and new year cheer to On Sum Kui 👶🧧❤✨
2026-02-13.enVenue: On Sum Kui Home for the Elderly
2026-02-13.enBody:
Children make short work of any distance. On 13 February 2026, in the middle of a festive Lunar New Year, our volunteers teamed up with a group of small helpers from Ying Yeung Lok Yi Anglo-Chinese Kindergarten and headed to On Sum Kui.

Our volunteers and the kindergarten teachers worked in step, leading the children and the residents through new year games and songs together.

The children sang their new year songs in small, entirely sincere voices, which had the residents laughing out loud, and offered their good wishes at full volume: "Wishing you good health, grandad, grandma!" In no time the care home had turned into about the happiest room in the city.

Watching the residents take their good wishes with those bright, contented smiles, and hearing them hold our hands, pat the children's heads and say "what a lovely, lively day — thank you LucaBridge and thank you to the children", made the effort disappear entirely.

This was more than a visit. It was a piece of cultural handover with no distance in it at all, in which children's faces did the work of paying respect to people who have given a lifetime to this society.

A loud thank you to the principal, teachers, students and parents of Ying Yeung Lok Yi Anglo-Chinese Kindergarten for their full support and commitment — what you showed is about as good a model of an inclusive community as there is. And our warmest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who led the day. 🔥🎒👶🧧✨

2026-05-11.enTitle: Inside the chamber: LucaBridge visits the Legislative Council at the invitation of member Hung Kam-yuen, and discusses the BTC programme with chairman Cheung Wai-lok 🦁🔥⚡✨
2026-05-11.enVenue: Legislative Council visit and Shenzhen-Hong Kong youth exchange
2026-05-11.enBody:
On 11 May 2026 we were honoured to be invited by Legislative Council member Hung Kam-yuen to bring our team into the Legislative Council Complex for a visit and a closer look at how Hong Kong is governed.

With Mr Hung guiding us and explaining as we went, we came away with a real understanding of how the Legislative Council works and how it has changed over time — the kind of understanding that a textbook or a television screen does not give you.

After the visit came the part that shaped the thinking: the Luohu Shenzhen-Hong Kong Youth Development exchange. The organisers had invited Mr Cheung Wai-lok, chairman of the Hong Kong Music, Sports and Culture Alliance, to speak. He gave a wide-ranging introduction to the Greater Bay Area Future Pillars Talent Cultivation Programme (BTC), which is about to launch in full, and led an energetic discussion on the opportunities and challenges facing young people in both Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

The session focused on how Luohu's position as a bridgehead for Shenzhen-Hong Kong integration can open a fast route north for Hong Kong young people looking to work, start businesses or simply make connections. There was plenty of debate about how culture, music and sport can widen exchange between young people on both sides, and how to bring on the people who will carry the next stretch.

Listening to two speakers of that calibre, our volunteers and the young people with us came away genuinely fired up.

This was more than a high-level visit; it was a reset in how we think, and a useful alignment of direction. It made clear what opportunities are open to young people now, and that LucaBridge has a part to play in connecting the two places and supporting young people as they grow.

A loud thank you to Legislative Council member Hung Kam-yuen for the invitation and for his confidence in us — thank you for opening that door. Our sincere thanks too to chairman Cheung Wai-lok of the Hong Kong Music, Sports and Culture Alliance for sharing so generously; the scope of what you both do is a real signpost for us.

And our warmest respect to the LucaBridge family who came and took it all in. May is off to a strong start. 🔥🏛🦁🎒🌍⚡✨

2026-05-12.enTitle: Sport, unlocked: LucaBridge meets Chiu Chow Association Secondary School and chairman Cheung Wai-lok to lock in our District Sports Festival plans ⚽🔥✨
2026-05-12.enBody:
We said we would, and we did. The day after discussing the Greater Bay Area Future Pillars programme (BTC) at the Legislative Council, our volunteers were at Chiu Chow Association Secondary School on 12 May 2026 for a working meeting with Mr Cheung Wai-lok, chairman of the Hong Kong Music, Sports and Culture Alliance, to get everything ready for what comes next.

Our core team arrived in uniform and got straight down to it. With Mr Cheung leading, we walked the school and checked off every detail — the layout, how people would move through the site, the sound equipment and the full running order. There was a lively discussion about how to bring sport, youth exchange and community care together properly, and how to make sure every part of it is safe and runs smoothly.

In the middle of all that came a genuine piece of good news: LucaBridge has been formally invited to take part in the District Sports Festival. That invitation reflects years of steady work in this community. The Festival exists to take sport into every corner of Hong Kong and get people moving, and we intend to bring that spirit straight to the residents we work with.

A loud thank you to chairman Cheung Wai-lok of the Hong Kong Music, Sports and Culture Alliance for his leadership and for his confidence in us — thank you for connecting LucaBridge to a platform with this kind of reach. Our sincere thanks too to Chiu Chow Association Secondary School for their strong support and for hosting us; your campus is a fine place to bring on the next generation of athletes. And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who worked through back-to-back days without flagging.

The details are settled and our run at the District Sports Festival is on. 🔥⚽🎒✨

2026-05-23.enTitle: Door to door in the Southern District: LucaBridge joins the Care Team at the invitation of councillors Wong Choi-lap and Cheung Wai-nam ❤📋🔥✨
2026-05-23.enBody:
Charity was never only about events; it is about turning up consistently. On 23 May 2026 we were honoured to be invited by Southern District councillors Mr Wong Choi-lap and Mr Cheung Wai-nam to join the Southern District Care Team for a full round of household visits.

It was a hot day, but our volunteers arrived in uniform and got straight into it. Working alongside the Care Team with registration lists in hand, we made our way through the estates and blocks of the Southern District.

At every household the volunteers gave it their full attention — handing over practical gifts, then sitting down beside the residents and the elderly people living alone and talking like family, listening carefully to how they had been eating, sleeping and managing, and updating each person's details as we went. "How have you been keeping? Is the flat comfortable? We've come round with the district councillors and the Care Team to see how you are."

That greeting was heard at one front door after another. Whatever residents raised about their circumstances, we wrote down carefully, building as complete a picture of the neighbourhood's needs as we could, so that supplies and social resources reach exactly the right people later on.

Watching the residents go from surprise to something much easier once they felt what LucaBridge and the Care Team had actually come for, and hearing them hold our hands and say "thank you to the councillors, thank you to the Care Team, and thank you especially to these young people from LucaBridge for climbing all those flights to see us" — that took the ache out of a day of stairs and heat entirely.

A loud thank you to Southern District councillors Mr Wong Choi-lap and Mr Cheung Wai-nam for the invitation and for their confidence in us; thank you for building a platform solid enough to let us serve the Southern District properly. Our sincere thanks too to every member of the Southern District Care Team for their support and easy cooperation; what you do sets the standard for looking after a community. And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who worked through the heat.

Nothing about people's daily lives is a small matter. 🔥🎒🏡📋❤✨

2026-05-24.enTitle: Back to the Gold Coast breakwater: volunteers and two young helpers dig litter out of the rocks 🚯🎒🌱✨
2026-05-24.enVenue: Gold Coast beach breakwater, New Territories West
2026-05-24.enBody:
Following the last clean-up, and to deal properly with a stretch that keeps getting hit, our volunteers returned on 24 May 2026 to the breakwater beside Gold Coast beach in the New Territories West.

The best part of the day was the two young volunteers who came along, making it a family effort across the generations.

It was hot, and the breakwater is a jumble of large rocks, which makes clearing it genuinely hard. Our two youngest volunteers were small but every bit as determined as the adults, with protective gloves on and pickers and bags in hand. Under the adults' close supervision, everyone crouched down, reached into the gaps in the rocks, and pulled out plastic bottles, discarded fishing net and barbecue litter bag by bag.

When it comes to environmental education, showing beats telling. Watching those two work steadily through the heat, entirely serious about it, and hearing one of them say "we have to clean up for the sea so the sea animals don't get hurt", got to everyone there. This was more than hard physical work; it was a proper handover to the next generation.

After most of a day, 5 bags stood ready to be carried away, and the breakwater was clean again. The pride among the volunteers and their young helpers was obvious.

A very loud well done to our two young volunteers, who worked without complaint and were outstanding. And our warmest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who keeps at this work.

Thank you for what you did for the New Territories West coastline. Conservation always needs doing, and we'll see you at the next one. 🔥🎒🌊🚯🌱✨
2026-05-24.enSummary: Following the last clean-up, and to deal properly with a stretch that keeps getting hit, our volunteers returned on 24 May 2026 to the breakwater beside Gold Coast beach in the New Territories West. The best part of the day was the two young volunteers who came along, making it a family effort across the generations.
2026-05-24.scTitle: 再战黄金泳滩，大爱无惧黑点！乐桥义工二度进击防波堤，带领两位小义工突击乱石缝，用汗水与承传换回洁净海岸线 🚯🎒🌱✨
2026-05-24.scVenue: 新界西黄金泳滩防波堤
2026-05-24.scBody:
守护蓝天碧海，乐桥永不退缩，更加后继有人！继上次清洁行动之后，为了彻底根治污染、还大自然一个舒适原貌，喺2026年5月24日，乐桥义工大队嘅热血战车再次驶入新界西嘅重灾区——黄金泳滩旁嘅防波堤。今次最令人振奋嘅，系团队增添了两位活泼精灵嘅**「星级环保小义工」**，实行全家总动员、跨代齐出汗，为香港嘅海洋生态注入最强续航力！

活动当日天气炎热，防波堤上巨石交错，清洁难度极高，两位小义工虽然年纪细细，但干劲完全唔输畀大哥哥大姐姐，戴好防护手套、拎起铁夹同垃圾袋，打足十二分精神。喺大义工嘅贴身安全照顾下，大家分工合作，猫低腰、探入石缝，将隐藏喺入面嘅塑胶樽、废弃渔网同烧烤垃圾一袋袋搜刮出嚟，成个团队展示出教科书级别嘅钢铁执行力！

环境教育，身教胜于言传。看著两位小义工一边流晒大汗，一边认真、执著咁清理垃圾，仲奶声奶气咁话：「我哋要帮大海执干净，唔好亲亲海洋生物受伤！」那一刻，在场嘅每一位义工家人都觉得无比动容同治愈。这不单止是一场极耗体力嘅义务工作，更是一场最完美、最深刻嘅跨代绿色承传，用下一代嘅纯粹双手，向社会宣示守护家园嘅坚定决心！

经过大半日嘅汗流浃背与无惧艰辛，5袋垃圾整齐排列准备运走。看著防波堤一瞬间回复了原本嘅洁净、美丽与舒适，那一刻，全场义工与小伙伴内心都涌现出无比嘅自豪与激昂！成就感直接冲破天际！在这里要大声为两位无惧辛劳、表现爆灯嘅小义工疯狂点赞！你哋展现出嘅童心与活力，简直系新世代最强嘅环保小先锋！同时亦要向当日全情投入、出汗出力、持之以恒深耕环保嘅每一位乐桥热血义工家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！

多谢你哋用双手同汗水，再次点亮了新界西嘅海岸线！山水相依，行胜于言！保育, 永远都需要，我们期待下一次既活动, 希望我们呢份正能量，可以继续守护香港每一片绿水青山，加油！🔥🎒🌊🚯🌱✨

Get the supplies laid out and check the equipment — tomorrow we give everyone the best sports festival we can." That kind of encouragement carried right across the site.

Watching an empty site turn, step by step and by our own hands, into a proper stage for a day of sport and celebration.

2026-05-30-2.enTitle: Across the border: LucaBridge joins the Communist Youth League's Luohu District exchange camp for Shenzhen and Hong Kong youth 🦁🔥⚡✨
2026-05-30-2.enBody:
Following the discussion of Shenzhen-Hong Kong opportunities at the Legislative Council on 11 May, our youth work reached another milestone on 30 May 2026. We were honoured to be invited by the Communist Youth League's Luohu District Committee in Shenzhen to take part in the "Youth Together, Chasing Bay Area Dreams" exchange.

Our young core team arrived in uniform and in good spirits. The whole programme was built around three ideas — integration, innovation and ambition — with the aim of opening a fast route for exchange of ideas and culture between young people in Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

Under the Luohu Committee's careful organisation, young people from both sides got on immediately and were quickly into substantial discussion, covering innovation and entrepreneurship, community volunteering, and the meeting point of culture and sport.

Our young representatives spoke with real energy about LucaBridge's long-running grassroots work in Hong Kong, our environmental programme and our work across generations, and showed exactly what this generation of Hong Kong young people is prepared to take on. The response from the Shenzhen delegates and organisers was warm and sustained.

This was rather more than a visit and a social. Watching young people from both places talk about the future with that much interest, shake hands, swap contact details and discuss how Luohu's position as a bridgehead for Shenzhen-Hong Kong integration might be put to use, the energy in the room was considerable.

Our thanks to the Communist Youth League's Luohu District Committee for the invitation, for their confidence in us and for organising it so well — thank you for pointing young people from both places towards real opportunities in the Greater Bay Area. And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who represented Hong Kong's young people so well on the day.

A strong close to May, and a new chapter for our youth and community work. 🔥🎒🌍⚡✨

Watching a group of bright, well-behaved children pick up a ping-pong ball, eyes fixed, taking careful aim.

A loud thank you to the District Sports Festival organisers, to the Hong Kong Music, Sports and Culture Alliance and to chairman Cheung Wai-lok for their leadership and for connecting us to the platform; with backing like that, LucaBridge can take creative charity work as far as it will go. And our warmest respect to every LucaBridge volunteer who stood at that stall all day and gave it everything. Every one of you did the work that day.

2026-06-09.enTitle: Law with a human face: LucaBridge attends the Hong Kong Arbitration Association charter event in support of mediation before arbitration ⚖🤝🔥⚡✨
2026-06-09.enBody:
On 9 June 2026 LucaBridge was honoured to be invited by the Hong Kong Arbitration Association to attend its Harmonious Hong Kong Charter event, bringing together leaders from the legal profession, business and the community in support of alternative dispute resolution.

The room was full of expertise, and the mood was both formal and warm. The centrepiece of the charter is a principle with a good deal of sense behind it: mediate first, arbitrate second. Through the speeches and discussions, practitioners and legal scholars set out clearly what that means in practice — when a dispute arises, start with mediation, which is measured and humane and listens to what each side actually wants, and look for the widest possible common ground; and if no agreement can be reached, then bring in arbitration, which is binding and efficient, to settle it.

That approach sits very comfortably alongside how LucaBridge has always worked in this community, where relationships and conversation across generations do most of the work. Listening to the speakers, our core team came away genuinely energised.

This was more than attending a high-level event; it changed how we think about something. Social harmony does not rest on rules alone — it needs bridges built from reasoned, tolerant conversation, and those have to be looked after.

The day opened up new lines of thinking for our community and youth work. Going forward we want to take this principle — value harmony, rely on the law — back into the neighbourhoods and into schools, and help young people and residents handle disagreement in a calmer and more constructive way.

A loud thank you to the Hong Kong Arbitration Association for the invitation and their confidence in us; thank you for building a platform with that much reach and letting LucaBridge be part of it. And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who came and took it in. 🔥⚖🤝🎒⚡✨

The room was full of expertise, and the mood was both formal and warm.
2026-06-09.scTitle: 情理法兼备，共筑和谐城！乐桥受香港仲裁公会邀请出席约章盛事，力撑「先调解后仲裁」核心理念，用专业与大爱守护香港稳定 ⚖🤝🔥⚡✨
2026-06-09.scBody:
以和为贵，专业赋能，共创香港美好明天！喺2026年6月9日，乐桥义工大队嘅发展蓝图再次迎来含金量极高、格局全方位破格嘅高光时刻！我哋非常荣幸获得香港仲裁公会嘅盛大邀请，走进这场汇聚了法律界、商界及社区领袖嘅**「和谐香港约章」活动**，实行用实际行动力撑多元化纠纷解决机制，为香港嘅长治久安贡献乐桥力量！

活动当日现场精英云集、气氛庄严而热烈。今次约章活动嘅重头戏，紧扣**「先调解，后仲裁」 **这一个极具智慧与前瞻性嘅核心理念。喺大会嘅星级分享与定点交流中，专业导师与法学专家深入浅出地阐述了这八字方针嘅精髓——在矛盾发生时，先透过具备温度、理性嘅「调解」去聆听各方诉求，寻求最大公约数；若未能达成共识，再进一步引入具备法律效力、高效嘅「仲裁」来定分止争。

这种教科书级别嘅定分止争模式，与乐桥一直以来深耕社区、强调人情味与跨代沟通嘅理念不谋而合！听完现场多位嘅精辟独到分享，我哋嘅热血骨干个个听得津津有味、眼神发光，内心涌现出无比嘅启发与澎湃动力！这不单止是一次高规格嘅活动出席，更是一场深刻嘅思想洗礼，让我们深刻明白到：社会嘅「和谐」不单止靠硬性嘅规范，更需要透过理性、包容嘅沟通桥梁去悉心守护！

这场盛会为乐桥未来嘅社区服务与青年工作打开了全新嘅思路。未来，我哋要把这份「以和为贵、以法为依」嘅精神带回基层、带入校园，引导两地青年与街坊用更理智、更和谐嘅方式处理分歧，携手织成一张覆盖全港、最牢固嘅和谐安全网！在这里要大声感谢香港仲裁公会嘅热情邀请与高度信任，多谢你哋搭建了如此高层次、具备社会影响力嘅平台，让乐桥能够参与到这场推动社会进步嘅历史浪潮之中；更要向当日全情投入、持之以恒吸收专业正能量嘅每一位乐桥热血家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！

和衷共济，善行不辍！六月份嘅前进步伐以最强专业格局震撼延续！让充满大局观与钢铁干劲嘅我们，全力为建设和谐香港、守护美好家园继续冲刺，让我们人生更精彩！🔥⚖🤝🎒⚡✨

2026-06-11.enTitle: Four regions, one conversation: LucaBridge joins the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation and the China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification to talk youth entrepreneurship 🌍🔥⚡✨
2026-06-11.enBody:
Following our earlier work on Shenzhen-Hong Kong exchange, LucaBridge stepped onto a wider stage on 11 June 2026. We were honoured to be invited by the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation to a forum on youth integration and development across the strait, Hong Kong and Macau, co-organised by the China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification.

Our young core team arrived in uniform and on good form for a day that brought together young people from all four places.

The programme was substantial, built around four main themes.

Cross-strait integration in a new era, and the responsibility of young people: a serious discussion of how young people across the strait, Hong Kong and Macau should step up and take on the work of national renewal and peaceful development.

Fujian-Taiwan cooperation policy and project briefings: an up-to-date explanation of the policy support available, and introductions to projects opening routes for young people from both sides to work on the western side of the strait.

Greater Bay Area development and the practice of One Country, Two Systems in Hong Kong and Macau: a detailed exchange on how Hong Kong's particular position makes it a core engine for the Bay Area, and an unmatched springboard for young people heading north.

Chinese-style modernisation and youth innovation and entrepreneurship: a look at how young people can fit their own ambitions into the wider picture, particularly in technology and culture.

Our thanks to the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation for the invitation and their confidence in us; thank you for building a platform of this standing. Our sincere thanks too to the China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification for co-organising and for pointing young people from all four places towards real opportunities.

And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who represented Hong Kong's young people so well. 🔥🎒🌍⚡✨

【粤港澳大湾区建设与港澳一国两制实践】：深入交流了香港在「一国两制」独特优势下，如何作为大湾区嘅核心引擎，为青年北上发展提供无可比拟嘅黄金跳板。【中国式现代化发展与青年创新创业】：聚焦中国式现代化嘅宏伟蓝图，探讨青年如何将个人嘅「双创」梦想融入国家发展大局，在科技、文化等前沿领域火力全开！在这里感谢香港岛青年联会嘅盛大邀请与高度肯定，多谢你哋搭建了具备社会影响力嘅顶级平台；同时亦要衷心感谢协办单位中国和平统一促进会嘅强力引领与智慧赋能，为四地青年指明了逐梦湾区、融入国家发展嘅黄金方向！

更要向当日全情投入、代表香港青年展现最强风采嘅每一位乐桥热血家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！同根同源，筑梦同行！前进嘅步伐以最强国家战略格局震撼延续！为两岸青年融合、为大湾区建设继续冲刺，我们下一站更精彩！🔥🎒🌍⚡✨

2026-06-16.enTitle: Hainan and Hong Kong: LucaBridge joins the 'Chill Hainan' forum at the JW Marriott to explore tourism paired with community work 🌊🤝🔥✨
2026-06-16.enBody:
Measuring the world through community work, and carrying goodwill through travel. On 16 June 2026 LucaBridge moved into new territory. We were honoured to be invited to the JW Marriott for "Chill Hainan", a high-profile promotional event for Hainan Province with a great deal of tropical energy about it.

The room was busy and full of significant names, and our core team arrived intending to get as much out of it as possible and to find a new opening for cooperation between the two places.

The programme showcased Hainan's appeal as an international tourism and consumption centre and set out the latest free trade port policy. On a platform like that, our team went looking for something deeper: how tourism and community work might be brought together across the two places.

We had a series of quick, productive conversations with tourism specialists and cultural tourism organisers about a model where people travel and do community work at the same time, taking Hong Kong young people north to experience Hainan's landscape and history while contributing something. That kind of trip breaks out of the sightseeing format entirely — when young people from two places sweat and contribute together, what they build between them is a good deal more solid.

Listening to the speakers and watching a plan take shape out of an idea, our young core team came away genuinely fired up. This was less a promotional event than a proper piece of cross-sector rethinking, and it showed us how much room there is in this kind of work.

The day opened a new route for our youth exchange and conservation programmes. Going forward we want to bring this energy back into the community, and get more young people out into the country to see something and do something useful while they are there.

Our thanks to the Hainan organisers and co-organisers for the invitation and their confidence in us; thank you for putting on something with that much international outlook. And our warmest respect to every member of the LucaBridge family who came and took it in. 🔥🎒🌴🌊🌍⚡✨

2026-06-16.scBody:
打破传统框架，用公益丈量世界，用旅游传递大爱！喺2026年6月16日，乐桥义工大队嘅战略视野再次昂首迈向全新领域！我哋非常荣幸获得邀请，前往高雅嘅JW万豪酒店，参与了这场充满热带活力、规格极高嘅「chill级近chill海南」海南省主题推广活动。大会现场气氛热烈、大咖云集，我哋全体骨干队伍个个打足十二分精神，实行要在这场盛会中汲取最强养分，为两地合作谋求全新突破！

当日活动精彩纷呈，全方位展示了海南作为国际旅游消费中心嘅独特魅力与最新自贸港政策。而喺呢个咁具备启发性嘅平台上，乐桥人更主动出击，将目光锁定在更深层次嘅社会价值上——我哋致力研究如何将旅游同公益概念带入两地发展！大家在现场与多位旅游专家、文旅推动者展开了火花四溅、高效率嘅定点交流，探讨如何透过「边旅游、边做公益」嘅全新概念，带领香港青年北上感受海南嘅自然风光与历史文化这种「旅游+公益」嘅双向奔赴模式，不单止能打破走马看花式嘅交流，更能让两地青年在共同流汗、共同奉献中，建立起最深厚、最纯粹嘅「心联通」！

听完现场多位领袖嘅精辟分享，看著蓝图在脑海中一步步由构思变成具体方案，我哋嘅热血青年骨干个个听得津津有味、眼神发光，内心涌现出无比嘅成就感与澎湃动力！这不单止是一次推广活动嘅出席，更是一场深刻嘅跨界思想洗礼，让我们看清了时代赋予绿色公益嘅无限可能！琼港相连，山海同心！这场盛会为乐桥未来嘅青年外访与生态保育工作开辟了全新嘅黄金通道。

未来，我哋要把这份「chill级」嘅环保与公益正能量带回社区，引导更多年轻人走出去，在广阔嘅祖国大地上边看世界边做实事，用双手织成一张更大、更广嘅大爱安全网！在这里要感谢海南省相关主办单位与协办单位嘅盛大邀请与高度肯定，多谢你哋带来了如此前卫、具备国际视野嘅文旅盛宴；更要向当日全情投入、持之以恒吸收创新正能量嘅每一位乐桥热血家人致以最崇高、最热烈嘅敬意！

心怀大局，逐梦山海！前进嘅步伐以最强跨界格局震撼延续！我们继续开足马力，为旅游与公益完美结合、为两地青年深度融合继续冲刺！🔥🎒🌴🌊🌍⚡✨

2026-06-19.enTitle: At the invitation of the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation: a screening of 'A Love Letter to Grandma', and a lesson in how one life reaches another 👵❤
2026-06-19.enBody:
On 19 June LucaBridge was honoured to be invited by the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation to a screening of the film "A Love Letter to Grandma". The story is told with real sincerity and care, and it moved everyone in the room. A few thoughts on it.

Honest and finely observed. The story weaves together two generations, setting an older person's life alongside what a younger one carries forward. It never reaches for sentiment, and yet the plainest, most everyday scenes are the ones that get you.

A clear illustration of one life reaching another. The film understands what company and listening are worth. An older generation lights the way with a lifetime of experience; a younger one answers with warmth and attention. That meeting across generations is exactly what we mean when we talk about one life influencing another.

A prompt to think about community care. This is a good film, but it is also a mirror. It reminds us that in the middle of a busy city it is worth stopping now and then to pay attention to the older people and the family around us.

Watching it lined up closely with what LucaBridge has always believed about bringing generations together and looking after a community. We will keep carrying that idea into the work we do.

Thanks again to the Hong Kong Island Youth Federation for the invitation, and for a warm and thought-provoking evening. ✨

2026-04-25.enTitle: Sham Tseng shoreline: six full bags of marine litter cleared, and the view back 💪
2026-04-25.enBody:
Our environmental team was out again, this time taking the clean-up to the Sham Tseng coast. Protecting marine life is a long campaign, not a one-off.

A group of volunteers gave up their day off, arrived at Sham Tseng beach early, pulled on gloves, picked up their litter pickers and got straight to work. The sand and the gaps between the rocks were covered in plastic bottles, disposable cutlery and waste of every kind, all drifted in from open water. Nobody minded the sun. They bent down and worked methodically along the length of the shoreline, leaving nothing behind.

A morning of sweat and good teamwork produced a striking result: six full bags of marine litter cleared. Watching a messy coastline return to being clean and pleasant, the satisfaction was considerable.

Our sincere thanks to every volunteer who worked hard and without fuss. It is your effort that keeps this sea healthy and worth looking at. We'll see you at the next one. ✨

2025-09-21-2.enTitle: Our strongest backing: LucaBridge's new volunteer uniform, with thanks to the businesses who paid for it 👕✨
2025-09-21-2.enBody:
🔥🎒💖 LucaBridge volunteer team: new uniforms, and thanks where thanks are due

【Our strongest backing — with thanks. LucaBridge's new volunteer uniform is here, made possible by a number of generous businesses 👕✨】

Behind every good scene in a community there is a group of people quietly paying for it and working for it. The reason our volunteers can turn out in all weather, in matching kit, is that we have a set of uniform sponsors with a great deal of goodwill behind them.

Our warmest thanks to the following businesses, who between them sponsored our volunteer uniforms (in no particular order): Wong Sun Kee Chicken and Duck, Kai Kee Store ⚓ Lik Sang Ho, Causeway Bay Sik Sun, Mai Kiu Physiotherapy Centre, Lui's Drainage Engineering Company Limited, Zhiqiao Foreign Language Education, and Wai Kee Trading Company Limited.

Because of your generosity, our volunteers now have a well-designed, comfortable uniform made for them — so that whether they are serving meals on the front line, clearing a coastline or visiting a care home, they can wear something that stands for goodwill and responsibility, and get on with it with confidence. What is printed on that uniform is not only a set of company names; it is evidence of businesses giving something back.

New uniform, new responsibility. With your backing, our volunteers walk this road on much firmer ground. Thank you again to every one of these businesses. 👕🎒❤
